He leaned over the railing, pulling the microphone away from his mouth.
"What is the delay?" the Announcer hissed impatiently.
The maid looked up with her face pale.
She reported the situation in a hushed whisper, but the magically amplified microphone still faintly picked up her words, echoing them softly across the quiet stadium.
"Contestant Onii-chan seemed to have digested something terrible," the maid reported, sounding genuinely concerned.
"He is hunched over in the locker room.
He became very, very sick just a few moments ago..."
The Announcer’s eyes widened.
Both of them, and everyone in the criminal Underworld who possessed a functional brain, knew exactly what that specific phrasing meant.
He hadn’t eaten bad fish.
He had obviously taken a massive handful of untested, black-market performance-enhancing pills to boost his strength, and his body was aggressively rejecting the toxic mixture.
"Is he forfeiting?" the Announcer asked sharply.
"Is he still coming out to the dirt?"
"He is," the maid confirmed while nodding rapidly.
"He is walking to the hatch now."
The Announcer straightened up, instantly floating his platform back up into the center of the arena.
He brought the microphone back to his lips with his voice taking on a tone of dramatic manufactured concern.
"Ladies and gentlemen, it seems we have a slight unexpected delay!" the Announcer announced to the massive crowd.
"Contestant Onii-chan seemed to have some severe issues with something he digested in the locker rooms!
He is currently extremely sick, but the Demon refuses to yield!
He is coming to the pit!"
Up in the tiered luxury boxes, a lot of the wealthy Managers and corporate sponsors gave each other knowing looks.
’Ah.’ the collective crowd realized.
It was quite clear to them now...
It made perfect logical sense!
Onii-chan had obviously been using high-tier performance-enhancing pills during the Battle Royale.
That was the only logical reason a human could have possibly possessed the raw physical strength to punch a three-hundred-pound cyborg into the ceiling.
There was nothing in the official rules of the Null-stone cage that said a fighter couldn’t chemically augment their own bloodstream.
It was a perfectly legal strategy in Shogitown.
But still... to suffer a total crash right before the brackets?
How many illegal pills did the idiot have to take to get that violently sick?!
Down in the dirt, Zarch the Reaper heard the announcement.
His chemically dilated pupils twitched.
He rolled his heavy mutated shoulders as he was feeling vastly more confident now.
The monster wasn’t a god, he was simply just another junkie who had pushed his dosage too far.
Zarch took a low unstable attacking stance, digging his boots into the mud.
"Come then...
I’ll make it quick..."
The Announcer raised his hand, officially giving the crowd a massive glowing blue holographic timer that appeared above the center of the cage.
"THREE MINUTES TO PLACE YOUR WAGERS!"
However, the entire field fell completely silent as heavy, dragging footsteps echoed from the dark tunnel.
Someone finally walked out from the opposite hatch.
It was Onii-chan.
But he truly did look incredibly sick.
Silas stepped out into the harsh stadium lights.
His broad shoulders were completely slumped forward, utterly ruining his intimidating posture.
He was dragging his feet through the dirt, staggering a bit to the left as if his inner ear equilibrium was completely destroyed.
He kept his head tilted downward and he clutched his stomach with one black-gloved hand, letting out a weak pathetic-sounding cough that vibrated hollowly through his Oni mask.
The stadium stared at him in disappointment.
Even the signature piercing light-blue glow of his eyes was gone.
Behind the narrow slits of his metal mask, there was nothing but dull, empty darkness.
Nobody could see anything resembling the Apex Predator from an hour ago.
As the heavy iron hatches slammed and locked closed behind him, the stadium’s silence shattered.
"BOOOOOOOOO!"
Thousands of spectators began viciously booing him, throwing their empty beer cups and crumpled betting slips against the Null-stone glass.
They felt cheated...
They thought they were going to see a monster but instead, they were looking at a dying addict!
The Announcer hovered closer, genuinely unsure if the match should proceed.
"Are you alright to fight, Contestant?" the Announcer asked.
Silas stood in the dirt.
He didn’t answer him as he just let out another weak rattling cough with his knees buckling slightly.
"Very well!
The betting window is open!" the Announcer declared, slamming his hand on his podium.
The personal holographic betting panels instantly appeared in front of every single spectator and Manager in the stadium.
"BEGIN THE MATCH!"
Just as the Announcer screamed, Zarch didn’t waste a single millisecond.
FWISH!

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Onii-Chan’s Defeat... Wait What The Hell Happened?
paragraphs: The hyper-stimulant drugs in his system ignited as Zarch completely speed-blitzed Silas.
WHOOOSH!
He moved faster than a human eye could properly track, crossing the fifty feet of packed dirt in a single explosive leap with the force so fast that it blew at the Announcer’s hair.
"SUCH POWER!"
He appeared directly in front of Silas like a teleporting nightmare.
"TAKE THIS!" Zarch roared, throwing a sweeping roundhouse kick directly forward, aiming straight for Silas’s ribs.
Silas, moving with sluggish pathetic lethargy, barely managed to raise his heavy forearms in time to block the incoming strike.
WHAM!
The impact sounded devastating.
"Gah!"
Silas let out a choked gasp, acting as if the air was violently knocked out of his lungs as he threw his body weight backward, perfectly selling the hit.
’That was a lot harder to do than I thought... Is my body that strong?’
He was sent flying completely sideways through the air, tumbling out of control.
CRASH!
Silas’s heavy body violently dug into the glowing blue wall of the Null-stone cage.
BZZZZZZZT!
"AHHHH!"
The anti-magic field reacted to the physical contact instantly, discharging a massive blinding arc of raw electricity directly into Silas’s uniform, violently electrocuting him.
Silas slumped forward off the bars, dropping to his hands and knees in the dirt.
Up in the stands, that was all the visual confirmation the people needed to begin voting.
The crowd went into a betting frenzy just like Silas wanted as they wildly tapped their holographic screens, abandoning Onii-chan.
"I’m putting every last credit on the Reaper! My entire life savings!" a scarred man yelled, frantically slamming his finger against his holographic betting tab.

"I fucking told you that stunt was complete bullshit," another spectator laughed smugly, leaning over the bleachers. "You don’t just punch a three-hundred-pound cyborg through solid rock... It was rigged!"

"Exactly! The kid’s a fraud," a third man chimed in, pointing down at Silas coughing in the dirt. "He just got incredibly lucky with a premium batch of combat stims, and now his body is completely crashing! Bet it all on Zarch, boys! We’re robbing the house tonight!"
Down in the dirt, Zarch on the other hand, was vibrating with chemical ecstasy.
"I can’t believe it...."
Was he this strong? Truly? If he was then he would win tonight and with the help of that man, his mother would be free.
He charged forward at Silas with his heavy boots kicking up massive chunks of mud.
"COME AT ME, ONII-CHAN!" Zarch screamed, his voice cracking horribly.
He reached Silas, throwing another massive brutal kick forward.
BAM!
The heavy boot collided directly with Silas’s supposedly unprotected stomach.
"Ugh!"
Silas hunched over violently, letting out a gagging sound behind his mask.
He actually spat out a massive glob of thick saliva onto the dirt, completely selling the internal organ damage.
’This guy’s technique is garbage...’ Silas thought to himself, completely bored out of his mind as he crouched in the mud.
Despite the incredible speed and raw chemical power behind Zarch’s strikes, the physical blows themselves felt like a toddler aggressively kicking a solid block of mythril.
Silas wasn’t using external mana but his regular bone density easily absorbed the shock without suffering a single micro-fracture.
The electrocution from the cage had stung a bit, like a nasty static shock from a doorknob, but it was nothing compared to a real lightning spell.
Silas forced his body to tremble as he raised a weak trembling fist and tried to punch forward, acting desperate.
’I just hope this acting is good... Once I’m done, I’ll kill this guy.’
Zarch smugly parried the slow punch.
"Too slow, you pathetic fraud!" Zarch taunted.
Zarch immediately landed a heavy chemical-fueled punch directly onto the side of Silas’s Oni mask.
BAM!
He followed it up with a relentless blindingly fast combination of hooks and jabs that battered Silas’s chest and shoulders.
BAM! BAM! BAM! BAM! BAM!
"HERE YOU GO!"
Zarch ended the flurry with a devastating spinning back-kick that struck Silas squarely in the chest plate.
THUD!
Silas was launched backward again.
This time, Silas bit the inside of his cheek hard enough to draw real blood.
As he flew backward, he let the blood pool in his mouth and spat it out, sending a visible horrifying spray of red blood flying from the bottom of his metal mask.
CRASH!
His broad back violently crashed directly into the towering wall of the Null-stone cage for a second time.
BZZZZZZZT!
He was electrocuted once again with the blue lightning arching across his shoulders.
"Ugh... Not again..."
Silas slumped down against the glowing bars, letting out a heavy convincing grunt of absolute pain as he let his arms hang limply at his sides.
Zarch threw his head back, throwing his arms wide open to the roaring crowd.
"HAHAHAHA!" Zarch began laughing, it was the sound of pure triumph. "I... FUCKING... WI—"
At that exact specific moment, the glowing blue holographic betting timer hovering over the center of the arena hit zero.
BEEP!
The timer completely finished.
Silas, still slumped against the electrified bars, caught the flashing red zero with the very corner of his eyes.
He watched as the blue betting tabs simultaneously disappeared from front of every single spectator in the stadium as the wagers were permanently locked and the house had finalized the odds.
’It’s about time...’ Silas thought, letting out a genuine annoyed sigh.
He stopped slouching.
’I’ll end this in one strike...’
He stood up completely straight. The sudden fluid shift in his posture was surprising given the beating he had just taken.

’The physical attacks of this man are quite strong,’ Silas critiqued internally, rubbing his gloved hand over his chest where Zarch had kicked him. ’But that was all there was to them... There’s no technique. It’s just raw stupid momentum.’
Zarch, completely oblivious to the sudden change in the demeanor, cut his victory laugh short.
He wanted to finish the execution.
"WHY YOU?! YOU WANT TO DIE, DON’T YOU?!"
He closed the remaining distance in a blur of hyper-stimulant speed, launching himself into the air.
He spun his body, unleashing a massive decapitating roundhouse kick aimed directly at the side of Silas’s silver demon face.
"No wait!"
High above, the Announcer saw the lethal strike coming.
He reached for his podium controls, desperately preparing to hit the buzzer and stop the match before Onii-chan’s head was kicked off his shoulders.
At that moment, the Announcer blinked.
He literally just blinked his eyes for a microscopic fraction of a second.
In the very next instant, before Zarch’s boot could even come within three feet of Silas’s mask...
KRA-THOOOOOOOOOM!
A terrifying and incomprehensibly powerful shockwave violently exploded outward from the exact spot where Silas was standing.
"Is that a spell?!"
No it wasn’t... It was simply a strike.
The shockwave ripped across the arena floor, blowing a massive circular crater into the packed dirt.

It hit the Null-stone cage and blasted violently upward, covering the audience in the lower stands too, physically making their expensive clothes blow wildly backward and knocking the drinks right out of their hands.
When the dust violently cleared, and the Announcer finally managed to open his wind-teared eyes, the entire colosseum froze in shock.
Silas was standing completely properly in the center of the crater.
He casually raised his black-gloved hands and stretched his broad shoulders, slowly cracking his thick neck from side to side with a series of loud pops.
The Announcer frantically looked around the arena. Where was the Reaper?
At the exact opposite, far side of the massive dirt field, nearly a hundred feet away from Silas, was Zarch.

The man seemed to be completely slumped backward against the towering Null-stone cage as the heavy blue electrical currents were continuously electrocuting him, frying his gear and sending thick plumes of black smoke into the air.
But there was no physical response from Zarch as he didn’t twitch nor did he scream.
Suddenly, Zarch’s upper torso simply slid sideways.
His body then fell over in two completely separate pieces.

He had been cleanly split entirely in two at the waist as the overwhelming force of Silas’s single invisible punch had launched Zarch across the arena with such terrifying velocity that the man’s spine had violently impacted one of the plentiful sharp broken iron support rods protruding from that far end of the damaged cage wall.
The rusted iron had acted like a guillotine.
The Announcer stared at the two halves of the Reaper smoking in the dirt with his jaw completely dropping.
’What... what in the actual fuck just happened?’ the Announcer thought, his brain completely failing to process the physics of the strike.
The match had literally ended in less than a single instant however Silas didn’t celebrate.
He just turned around, looking up at the Announcer’s floating platform.
"I failed to hold back properly," Silas told the Announcer with a sigh. "And as a direct result, this guy has died. The match is over... Can I go back to the locker room now?"
The Announcer blinked blankly with his mind short-circuiting. He just mutely nodded his head.
’I bet on Zarch too... was this his plan all along?’
The heavy steel hatch on Silas’s side of the arena immediately ground open.
Silas didn’t wait for permission. He turned and casually walked out of his own dark tunnel, leaving the bloodbath behind.

Simultaneously, from the hatch where Zarch had originally come out from, a massive team of Underworld cleaners in rubber suits were frantically rushing out with body bags and hoses to handle the two halves of the steaming corpse.
High up in the luxurious soundproofed VIP private room, Evelyn was standing perfectly still by the reinforced glass window.
She stared down at the bisected corpse of Zarch the Reaper.
She was genuinely a bit shaken at exactly how easy and how utterly casual it had been for Silas to kill someone with his bare hands.
He didn’t even hesitate... He just deleted a human life and asked for permission to leave.
’Didn’t he feel any guilt for it at all?’ Evelyn wondered with a chill running down her spine.
She swallowed hard, looking at the massive crater Silas had left in the dirt.
And then, she logically corrected herself.
’We’re Lords...’ Evelyn thought.
Even though Evelyn herself possessed a deep trauma about killing people which was the exact reason she had spared that sniper in the alleyway earlier...
It didn’t mean that Silas shared her civilian sentiment.

Given the terrifying nature of the Umbral Basin he had been summoned to, and the horrors he had fought to secure his territory, it was certainly a matter of kill or be killed on a daily basis for him.
He was a Lord and he didn’t have the luxury of hesitation. So, she was not going to judge his brutal methods in a death-match.
’I should do the same... I’m a Lord too.’
Suddenly, a soft pinging echoed from the velvet sofa behind her.
Evelyn turned around.
The glowing blue holographic betting tab appeared floating in front of her datapad, finalizing the locked odds of the match.
Because Silas had so flawlessly acted like a dying poisoned addict for the entire three-minute betting window, the entire stadium had completely dumped their money onto Zarch.
The house odds on Onii-chan had skyrocketed to astronomical historic underdog proportions!
Evelyn stared at the screen.
Evelyn’s eyes widened behind her Kitsune mask as her breathing stopped.
She lunged forward.
Her small leather-gloved hand slammed violently down onto the glass coffee table, rattling the crystal decanters.
"JACKPOT, BABY!" Evelyn yelled at the top of her lungs, throwing her arms into the air in a display of pure goblin greed.
Simultaneously, down in the arena, the Announcer finally managed to regain his voice.
"L-LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!" the Announcer stammered into his microphone, his voice echoing over the silent crowd. "CONTESTANT ONII-CHAN HAS WON THE MATCH!"
The silence broke.
The entire crowd went feral... It was even more so than the last time.
They threw their chairs, smashed their empty bottles and screamed, crying, and cursing Onii-chan’s name into the dark ceiling.
They had all been completely scammed out of their life savings by a man pretending to cough and take a beating!
"FUCK YOU, ONII-CHAN!"
"I HOPE YOU GET CUCKED LOSER!"
"I HOPE YOU DIE TONIGHT!"
"I HOPE BOTH SIDES OF YOUR PILLOW WILL BE WARM TONIGHT!"
Everyone turned to the man who said that, did he have no shame? Why would he mention something that belonged in a LordTube video comment section in real life?
’What a weirdo...’
Silas let out a tired sigh.

It had taken quite a bit of time to navigate his way from the lower, blood-soaked locker rooms back up to the luxurious VIP levels without the polite maid there to guide him through the labyrinth of guarded corridors.
As he walked down the plush crimson-carpeted hallway, he could physically feel the murderous stares of the Syndicate guards and staff.
’I really don’t like those looks...’ Silas thought while keeping his hands near his pockets.
Every single person he was coming across in the hallways was giving him a weird hostile look.
The guards were practically gripping their rifles, glaring at his Oni mask with pure hatred.

’So what if I lied about being wounded or poisoned or whatever?’ Silas reasoned internally. ’It was for my own personal gain. Why the hell are they acting like they have the moral high ground? Every single person in this entire building is a criminal here for their own personal gain... Fucking Hypocrites.’

Why the hell are they acting like they have the moral high ground?
Every single person in this entire building is a criminal here for their own personal gain...
Fucking Hypocrites.’

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Dignity Has A Price [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: "Finally..."
Silas finally reached the gilded oak door of Evelyn’s private suite, it was a grueling journey especially after thinking about ripping the heads of those people constantly.
"I’m coming in."
He opened the heavy door and stepped inside, closing and locking it firmly behind him to block out the noise of the hallway.
Evelyn was still seated exactly where he had left her on the curved velvet sofa.
She wasn’t smoking anymore as she just had a wide ecstatic smile plastered across her pale face, completely visible beneath the raised edge of her Kitsune mask.
"Did the acting plan go out well?" Silas asked casually, unbuttoning his dark top of the uniform to vent the heat of the fight.
Evelyn didn’t even use words to answer as she just confirmed it with a frantic enthusiastic nod.
"Proof?"
She grabbed her glowing datapad and physically flipped it around to show him the screen.
Silas looked at the glowing numbers.
Silas nodded.
’I’m impressed for myself... my acting skills are that good? If I didn’t become a Lord, I could have been an actor.’
He walked over to the sofa and formally extended his large black-gloved hand outward for a business handshake.
Evelyn immediately reached out and returned the firm grip.
They both gave each other a single synchronized nod of their heads, completely united by the sheer thrill of financial robbery.
"You’re an incredibly good business partner." Evelyn said, her dark eyes shining with respect.
"I agree, that’s what I am..." Silas replied smoothly, dropping her hand. "But you are also incredibly lazy for just staying up here in the air conditioning while I do all the actual manual labor."
Evelyn’s lips instantly thinned into a flat annoyed line.
She immediately tried to aggressively squeeze his fingers in her grip to punish his insolence, channeling her strength.
’Fuck...’
It didn’t work. Grabbing Silas’s hand felt exactly like trying to crush a solid block of reinforced steel as he didn’t even flinch.
"Haa... Even your brain is made of muscle." Evelyn cursed as she let go of his hand while rubbing her sore fingers.
’Should I tell her hers is made of tobacco or cigarettes?’
She quickly changed the subject, tapping the console on the glass table.
"The next fight is about to begin in the dirt," Evelyn said, maximizing the massive floating holographic tab that projected the arena feed into the center of the room.
She patted the empty velvet cushion right beside her thigh.
"Do you want to sit down and watch the live feed of your next potential opponents together?" Evelyn asked.
Silas just stood there.
He gave her a long flat and exhausted look through the narrow slits of his Oni mask.
’Do we have to...?’
He didn’t want to watch the fights as those guys were weak, if Silas could, he just wanted to sleep.
Regardless, he reluctantly walked over and sat down heavily on the edge of the sofa, keeping a respectable foot of distance between them.
Evelyn looked at his slumped posture.

"You haven’t even actually rested your muscles since we got to Shogitown," Evelyn pointed out, her voice softening slightly with genuine concern as she patted her own legs. "Would you like to lay down and rest your head on my soft lap while we watch? I heard young guys like you like that... You know to rest your head on the thighs of an older woman such as myself."
Silas slowly turned his head.
He gave her another look.
It was a look that communicated a thousand words of judgment, completely shutting down the intimate suggestion. That was all that needed to be said.
However, Evelyn, fueled by the adrenaline of winning sixty million credits, didn’t want to give up the banter.
’I won’t give you the satisfaction of walking away from this scot-free... but how... how do I convince him?’ Evelyn thought and then her eyes lit up, how could she forget?!
"I’ll pay you a cool one million Spirit Credits if you do it," Evelyn offered, crossing her arms with a smug grin. "Consider it a bonus... It’s for your own physical sake as you need the rest."
Silas didn’t even blink as he continued staring straight ahead at the hologram.
Seeing that he wouldn’t budge for a million, she aggressively increased the bid.
"Not going to answer eh? Fine... Three million credits this time." Evelyn challenged.
Silas still didn’t budge an inch. Instead he let out a deep tired sigh.
"I already have seventy-five million credits sitting securely in my personal bank account," Silas stated dryly while stating a fact. "Why the hell would I possibly nee—"
"Twenty million." Evelyn called the absurd number without a second of hesitation and Silas stopped talking instantly.
’Ah... I’m a sucker for money, aren’t I?’
Silas immediately shifted his body weight sideways on the velvet sofa, kicked his combat boots up onto the armrest, and gently rested his head directly onto the soft exposed skin of her pale thighs.

’Twenty million?’ Silas justified the sudden loss of his personal space with pure logic. ’Letting an easy twenty million credits just go by for the sake of pride? Is she insane? I would sell out the World Council to a demon lord for half that.’
Twenty million was money... and Silas wasn’t exactly the kind of person to waste money, even if he did have a lot of it.
"Hehehehe~"
Evelyn burst out laughing, looking down at the terrifying demon mask resting comfortably on her lap.
"You are so utterly shameless!" Evelyn giggled, thoroughly enjoying the victory. "Selling your entire dignity and your personal boundaries for twenty million credits? You are so cheap!"
"Shut up and pay me," Silas muttered from her lap, closing his eyes.
Evelyn smiled softly.
She gently reached down with her hand with her fingers slowly, rhythmically stroking the dark and slightly damp hair at the back of his head.
"Just rest," Evelyn told him quietly. "And watch the screen."
The holographic screen in the center of the room flared brightly, lighting up the dim suite, and a secondary smaller betting screen instantly appeared hovering right beside it.

’So who should I bet on?’ Evelyn thought, even if Silas was not participating right now... who was to say she couldn’t make money? ’Let’s go for Blood Saint, I’m not dumb enough to put all my money on him though! Let’s say 5 million!’
She tapped it and it only had a return of 50, 000?
’Dammit!’
Down in the massive newly cleaned arena, the roaring crowd had settled back into their seats.
The Announcer’s voice boomed over the speakers.
"LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! THE SECOND MATCH OF THE BRACKET IS UPON US!" the Announcer declared. "THE TWO FIGHTERS OF ROUND TWO WILL NOW BE STEPPING INTO THE FIELD!"
The heavy steel hatches ground open immediately.
"In the red corner, the man with the scalpel... THE SURGEON!"
The thin and unnervingly calm wiry man stepped out into the dirt. He was wearing his pristine freshly cleaned translucent vinyl medical apron and his glowing surgical goggles.
"And in the blue corner... the zealot of the slaughter... BLOOD-SAINT!"
The terrifying fanatic wearing the tattered blood-soaked priest’s robes stepped out with his bare feet sinking into the mud.
The two armed killers walked slowly toward each other on the massive field.
They stopped and stood exactly thirty feet away from each other in the center of the ring.
CLANG!
The heavy steel hatches slammed completely closed behind them as the Null-stone cage hummed violently to life, sealing them inside the anti-magic field.
The Surgeon, maintaining his cold persona, adjusted his glowing goggles.
He looked at the crazed priest and tried to start some light psychological small talk before the buzzer.
"Your cardiovascular system appears highly elevated," The Surgeon noted smoothly, raising his hands. "I can perform a quick permanent operation to relieve that pressure for you..."
The Surgeon paused as he suddenly coughed softly into his hand, clearing his throat.
"I have a condition... don’t mind me..."
Blood-Saint didn’t say a single word in response.
He just stood there with his head tilted slightly to the side.
There was a completely crazed unfocused look in his wide bloodshot eyes... one that the good doctor knew all too well, a look that promised nothing but torturous blood.
BEEEEEEP!
The starting buzzer blared and the very instant the fight officially started, The Surgeon didn’t hesitate.
He was a professional killer after all.
WHOOSH!
He immediately leapt backward with incredible acrobatic agility to create distance and while mid-air, his hands blurred into his dirty blood-stained robes.
"I hope you like my gift, Bloood Sain– Gah! Saint!"
He smoothly retrieved six perfectly balanced throwing scalpels and with a flick of his wrists, he shot all six blades through the air simultaneously.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
He threw them with terrifying pinpoint accuracy as the scalpels whistled through the air, heading directly over to the unmoving Blood-Saint.
SHLUCK! SHLUCK! SHLUCK!
The sharp wet impacts echoed over the dirt.
All six blades buried themselves deeply into Blood-Saint’s chest, neck, and thighs as they struck the exact vital spots required to sever the major arteries and puncture the lungs.
The Surgeon landed gracefully on his feet in the dirt.
He smirked beneath his goggles.
’And just like that, it’s over...’
He had hit the lethal marks naturally, A regular human couldn’t survive that much internal bleeding for more than five seconds.
Only for a massive blood-soaked hand to suddenly violently seize The Surgeon’s right ankle.
The Surgeon’s eyes widened in terror as he let out a choked terrified gasp.
"Ghk!"
He looked down.
Blood-Saint was literally crouching directly in front of him, gripping his leg with the crushing force of a hydraulic press.
The six scalpels were still buried deeply into the priest’s flesh, but he completely ignored the fatal wounds.
The Surgeon’s mind shattered.
’It has been less than a single instant...’ The Surgeon panicked internally, struggling to pull his leg free. ’How the fuck did he get here? How is he still physically moving with a punctured lung?!’
Blood-Saint slowly looked up, his face twisted into a horrifying wide smile.
"My god has spoken to me," Blood-Saint whispered with his voice becoming a wet rattling rasp.
He casually ripped one of the scalpels out of his own neck with blood pouring down his chest. "He predicted that you would die a very, very horrible death tonight."
Before The Surgeon could even open his mouth to scream for a forfeit—
Blood-Saint stood up, lifting the screaming Surgeon entirely upside down by his ankle.
"RAHHHHHHHH!"
With a roar of pure strength, Blood-Saint swung the struggling man violently downward like a human baseball bat.
SPLAT!
He slammed The Surgeon’s face and upper skull directly, brutally down into the packed dirt of the arena floor.
The impact was sickening.

It literally popped the man’s head completely open like a dropped, overripe melon, instantly spraying a massive fountain of dark red blood and brain matter all over the dirt and the priest’s tattered robes.
THUD!
The sickening sound of the Surgeon’s headless body hitting the packed dirt echoed through the sudden horrifying silence of the colossal arena.
"That was quite easy..."
Blood-Saint didn’t even bother wiping the thick spray of gray brain matter and dark crimson gore from his pale twitching face.
He casually opened his massive blood-soaked hand as he completely released his crushing grip on the dead man’s ankle.
The Surgeon’s limp decapitated corpse hit the mud with its limbs giving one final, pathetic twitch against the dirt before going permanently still.
Blood-Saint slowly stood up to his full towering height as he threw his long arms wide open to the roaring stadium with his tattered priest robes flapping heavily in the drafts of the cavern.

’This man... is he mad?’ The Announcer thought, It was such a brutal show that it could not even be called a fight... It had been a simple slaughter and the man felt if he looked at the priest right now, he might be the next too.
Blood-Saint slowly turned his crazed bloodshot eyes across the massive dirt field as he ignored the Announcer and he ignored the thousands of screaming fans.
He locked his manic gaze directly onto the dark shadowed tunnel where Silas had exited earlier.
"THE DEMON IS NEXT!" Blood-Saint roared into the air.
His voice wasn’t just loud but it possessed a power that easily overpowered the ambient noise of the thousands of screaming spectators.
It sounded like a man drowning in his own lungs, yet possessing the strength of a titan.
"HEAR ME! I WILL BE SLAUGHTERING ONII-CHAN NEXT!" Blood-Saint shrieked, pointing a dripping crimson-stained finger at the empty hatch. "HIS BLOOD WILL BE A SACRED OFFERING TO MY GOD!"

chapters.title: Chapter 368: Blood Magic
paragraphs: He laughed.

It was a manic sound of pure ecstasy as he turned his back on the carnage he had just created and calmly walked off toward his designated exit hatch with his bare feet leaving bloody footprints in the mud.
High above the cage, the neon-suited Announcer swallowed hard as he wiped a thick bead of cold sweat from his forehead.
’Thankfully he’s gone now...’
He gripped the railing of his floating anti-gravity platform with a trembling hand, raising his magically amplified microphone to his lips.

"W-WHAT AN UNFORGIVING DISPLAY OF BRUTALITY, LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!" the Announcer’s voice boomed through the massive stadium speakers, forcing the hype back into his voice. "THE SURGEON HAS BEEN DISMANTLED! THE VICTOR OF ROUND TWO... IS THE BLOOD-SAINT!"
The crowd erupted into a massive bloodthirsty cheer, tossing their winning betting slips into the air like confetti.
"CLEAN-UP CREW TO THE DIRT!" the Announcer ordered over the PA system. "WASH THE MUD! WE HAVE MORE FIGHTS TONIGHT!"
The heavy steel hatches built into the Null-stone walls ground open with a metallic screech.
Immediately, the designated Underworld clean-up crew rushed forward out of the dark maintenance tunnels.
There were four of them.
Hardened men wearing heavy, industrial-grade rubber aprons, thick insulated boots, and full-face gas masks to block out the overwhelming stench of the slaughter.
Two of them pushed a rusted, flatbed metal cart, while the other two carried high-pressure water hoses.

"I’m telling you right now," a cleaner named Grits grumbled, his voice muffled behind his heavy respirator mask. "I call dibs on the Surgeon’s boots... Those are genuine imported synth-leather. Worth at least two hundred Spirit credits on the black market."

"You can have the boots, you vulture," his partner, a massive guy named Jaxson, snorted, pushing the rusted cart over a crater. "I just want to check his pockets... These high-tier assassins always carry backup cred-chips."

"Just grab the meat and throw it on the cart," the team leader barked, unrolling the thick water hose. "The Boss wants this ring spotless in three minutes so move your asses before the snipers get bored and start using us for target practice."
Grits and Jaxson reached the Surgeon’s headless bleeding body.
"Jesus, he popped him like a cheap balloon," Grits muttered, looking down at the ruined stump of the neck.
"Grab the ankles," Jaxson sighed, bending his knees. "I’ll grab the shoulders. On three. One. Two. Three..."
The two men reached down.
The exact second their thick rubber gloves made physical contact with the dead cooling flesh.
SQUELCH! BOOOOOOM!
The Surgeon’s dead body violently exploded.
It wasn’t an explosion caused by a hidden bomb as it was a horrifyingly biological one.
Every single remaining drop of blood trapped inside the corpse’s veins violently, instantly pressurized and the dead flesh ruptured outward in a high-speed geyser of dark red fluid.
The blood wasn’t normal... It was highly corrosive and it was magically charged too!
The thick spray of acidic blood shot directly upward, blasting straight across the face of Jaxson.
"AGGGHHHH!" Jaxson screamed.
HISSSSSS!
The heavy industrial gas mask he was wearing instantly began to melt. The thick plastic fused directly to his skin, turning into a bubbling toxic sludge.
Jaxson dropped completely to his knees in the dirt, abandoning the cart.
He clawed wildly, desperately at his own sizzling face as the blood literally ate through his flesh, his muscles, and his bone like high-grade industrial acid.
"Help him! Holy shit, help him!" Grits screamed, stumbling backward and tripping over the cart in pure terror.
The remaining blood splashed heavily onto the packed arena floor.
It hissed violently, bubbling and smoking as it rapidly sank deep into the ground, leaving massive blackened craters in the mud.
The roaring crowd went instantly dead silent.
Thousands of people just stared in horror at the melting cleaner thrashing and screaming on the ground with his face completely dissolving into a red puddle.

High up in the soundproofed climate-controlled VIP private suite, Silas and Evelyn were staring intensely at the massive glowing holographic live feed projecting the arena floor into the center of their room.
They watched the cleaner screaming on the ground and they watched the acidic blood eat straight through the solid dirt.
"Well," Evelyn muttered, taking a slow drag of her premium Red-Lotus cigarette.
She exhaled a thin stream of smoke toward the ceiling. "That definitively confirms it. He definitely has a Lord core."
Silas could easily see it too.
His golden-ringed eyes missed nothing.

Given the physics-breaking way that Blood-Saint had closed the thirty-foot distance to the Surgeon in seconds earlier, it was blatantly obvious to anyone with combat experience that the crazed priest was actively using internal mana to strengthen his muscle fibers.
But still... the actions of the dead body violently exploding after death were very weird.
The massive Null-stone cage explicitly prevented external mana projection.
You couldn’t cast a spell outside your body. You couldn’t throw a fireball, summon a weapon, or trigger a magical trap from across the room...
"He is probably a fanatic supporter of the Blood Deity, Xvesu," Evelyn deduced, her brain rapidly piecing the visual evidence together.
Silas blinked behind the narrow metal slits of his Oni mask.
He was still laying incredibly comfortably on the sofa with his heavy head resting on Evelyn’s soft bare thighs.
He looked up at her chin with his brain processing the new intel.
He knew about the concept of deities.
’They’re like Ititius and Thor...’
They absolutely existed in the higher echelons of the Sovereign Realm, hell he even had a Goddess currently living in his own territory back in the Blessed Land.
But who the hell was Xvesu?
Evelyn saw the obvious genuine confusion radiating from his masked face.

"On one of my earlier streams," Evelyn explained quietly, tapping an ash from her cigarette into a heavy crystal tray resting on the glass table. "I had my army push deep into the territory of a Lord who specialized in Blood Magic. He was a sworn fanatical supporter of Xvesu."
Silas listened intently, keeping his head perfectly still, enjoying the rare moment of rest.

"Xvesu is an incredibly obscure and violent dark god," Evelyn continued, her voice turning completely serious. "He grants his followers the ability to manipulate the iron and the latent mana existing inside blood cells. It increases the physical, destructive power of their own blood by several fold, turning it into an acidic weapon."
Evelyn pointed her glowing cigarette tip directly at the holographic screen, gesturing to the smoking acidic craters left on the ground where the Surgeon had just exploded.

"If you are facing Blood-Saint in the final bracket," Evelyn warned him, her dark eyes locking onto the silver fangs of his mask. "You have to be incredibly careful, Silas. Even though the Null-stone cage strictly dictates that he can’t use mana outside of his body to cast a spell..."
Silas nodded slowly, instantly finishing her sentence.

"The blood itself is a physical biological object," Silas said. "It inherently contains the mana. If the blood leaves his body, or his opponent’s body, he can still manipulate it physically without triggering the Null-stone suppression."
It was a massive loophole in the arena’s rules.
’I really have to learn Blood magic...’
Silas let out a deep sigh as the breath vibrated the metal fangs of his demon mask, sounding like a growling beast.
"I’ll be careful," Silas assured her.
He wasn’t particularly worried about a blood mage or whatever.
He had an entire ocean of Mythic Gold Core mana coursing through his own veins and his bone density was practically adamantium so a puddle of acidic blood didn’t impress him.
He shifted his broad shoulders against the plush velvet cushions.
"Can I get up now?" Silas asked, gesturing to the fact that his head was still firmly planted in her lap. ’She’s still owing me too... tch.’
Evelyn immediately placed her small leather-gloved hand directly onto his dark hair.
"Not yet," Evelyn commanded softly.
She gently rubbed her fingers through his hair to keep him anchored to her thighs. "Stay with me while I think of a plan."
Silas sighed again, crossing his heavy arms over his chest and resigning himself to his fate as a paid lap dog.

"We need to figure out exactly how we’re going to confidently talk to the Boss of the Black-Ash Syndicate when we’re done robbing his casino blind," Evelyn muttered, staring at the ceiling of the suite as her mind rapidly plotted negotiations.

"We just pay him the credits for the hacker if he refuses..." Silas stated the obvious. "It’s a simple straightforward transaction if he doesn’t honor the deal, We buy the Slave Rune trigger and we leave."
Evelyn blinked.
Her dark eyes widened behind her painted Kitsune mask as she realized she had completely omitted a critical piece of tactical intel during their initial briefing.
"Oh, did I tell you?" Evelyn asked casually, looking down at his masked face.
Silas frowned behind the metal. "Tell me what?"
"Apparently, Jax is directly related to the Boss," Evelyn casually dropped the bombshell. "He is his actual son so buying him is going to be a lot harder than we originally thought."
Silas completely froze.
"But hey," Evelyn shrugged, completely oblivious to the gravity of what she had just said. "At least this goddamn underground competition will soon be over, right?"
Silas’s golden-ringed eyes flew wide open behind his mask.
He lifted his heavy head up off her lap, turning his Oni mask to stare directly into her dark eyes with disbelief.
"He’s what?!" Silas demanded.
Down in the colossal echoing cavern, time rapidly passed.
The Announcer hovered his anti-gravity platform over the center of the freshly cleaned, heavily blood-soaked field.
It was finally about time for the climax of the night.
The following bracket matches had taken place in rapid and completely unforgiving succession.
The crowd had been treated to a staggering uninterrupted display of Underworld violence.
The remaining elite fighters had viciously eliminated each other one by one, tearing cybernetics and spilling gallons of blood onto the mud.

In a bizarre entertaining twist that had cost the house millions, two of the heavy cybernetic fighters... Rust-King and Ironhide Rex had actually killed each other simultaneously in a brutal screeching double-knockout that involved a lot of torn metal and sparking wires and as for Neon Blade, he was killed unfortunately and stuffed in his changing locker.
The Black-Ash Syndicate were still trying to find out what happened to him.
Which left exactly four contestants remaining for the entire tournament.
Onii-chan... Blood-Saint... Cyber Ghost... Goliath-9...
Fortunately for the house, they were all strong, entertaining and fan-favorite fighters.
"Haah..."
But the Announcer was sweating through his neon-purple suit.

He nervously pulled at his collar. He still desperately needed a way to maximize the betting lines and aggressively market this whole finale to recoup the massive credit loss the house had suffered from Onii-chan’s fake illness stunt.
Suddenly, the secure encrypted comms earpiece in the Announcer’s right ear vibrated violently.
He tapped it instantly.
"Yes, Boss?" the Announcer whispered frantically, turning his back to the roaring crowd so the cameras wouldn’t catch his panicked expression.

"The standard one-on-one brackets are completely boring to me," the deep calm and authoritative voice of the Black-Ash Boss echoed directly into his ear. "I don’t want to sit here and watch two more drawn-out semi-finals. It will take too long."
The Announcer swallowed hard with his throat turning dry. "A... a four-way match, Sir?"

"Call all four of the remaining fighters up to the dirt right now," the Boss commanded coldly with his tone brooking no argument. "We are doing a four-way mini-royale. It prevents the crowd from getting bored, it spikes the betting algorithms, and we can finish this whole pathetic thing in one go. Do it..."
CLICK!
The encrypted line went dead.
The Announcer frantically nodded his head to the empty air.
He spun his floating platform around, facing the roaring stadium as he took up his magically amplified microphone with a massive fake grin plastered across his sweaty face.
"LADIES AND GENTLEMEN OF SHOGITOWN!" the Announcer screamed, his voice booming like rolling thunder across the cavern. "WE HAVE A MASSIVE CHANGE OF PLANS!"
The massive crowd went breathlessly silent, listening intently to the floating man.

"INSTEAD OF A BORING SEMI-FINALS... THE SPONSORS HAVE DECIDED TO ESCALATE THE CARNAGE TO ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM LEVELS!" the Announcer roared, throwing his arms wide. "A FINALS WILL THEN BE HOSTED! A FOUR-WAY SUDDEN-DEATH MINI-ROYALE!"
The crowd was initially surprised by the sudden blatant breaking of the established tournament rules.
But within exactly two seconds, the degeneracy of the Underworld took over.
They were even more hyped!
A massive four-way death match between the strongest killers in the city?
"YES!"
"BLOOD! WE WANT BLOOD!"
They began cheering with intensity, throwing their hands, their drinks, and their remaining credits into the air.
High up in the lower VIP stands, sitting in a guarded bulletproof security booth.
The wicked black-haired receptionist slowly stood up from her squeaking leather chair.
She gracefully smoothed out the wrinkles in her expensive black corporate suit.
’It’s time, huh?’ the receptionist thought to herself, tossing her smoking Red-Lotus cigarette into a glass ashtray. ’I better go meet Dad in the main suite.’

Thousands of people just stared in horror at the melting cleaner thrashing and screaming on the ground with his face completely dissolving into a red puddle.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: The Final Round [I / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: She already had a completely clear idea of exactly who would walk out of that pit alive.
’Of course it’ll be him...’
From the reinforced security booth perched just beneath the mid-tier VIP promenade, the receptionist adjusted the cuff of her charcoal-black tailored blazer.
Through the heavy polarized safety glass, the colosseum looked like a churning cauldron of filth, blood, and flashing neon wagers.
Down in that dirt, men died for pocket change and a few scraps of glory.
’I’ve watched everything... and I can’t say I’m disappointed.’𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎

She had watched the Demon in the silver Oni mask, the lunatic calling himself Onii-chan, completely defy the established laws of physics, crushing bone density and reinforced steel alike with the casual indifference of a man swatting a mosquito.
The other three fighters scheduled to step through those gates were dead men walking.
They just hadn’t received their official death certificates yet.

And so, as the legitimate blood-born daughter of the Boss of the Black-Ash Syndicate, she would legally need to be present for the final asset negotiations regarding her runaway degenerate hacker brother.
’I wonder why Onii-chan wants him so much though...’
PSSH-T!
She tapped the hydraulic override switch on the security panel, and the heavy steel door to her booth hissed open.
The moment she stepped out into the carpeted private corridor, she was flanked instantly by two massive hulking cybernetic bodyguards.
Their pneumatic joints hissed with every step with their heavy armor plates grinding together beneath broad synthetic trench coats.
Click! Clack! Click! Clack!
Her high heels made sharp taps against the plush deep-crimson carpeting of the executive promenade.
"Haah..."

’Why the hell does this whole massive bloody event have to be about that greasy fucker Jax?’ she thought, rolling her dark kohl-rimmed eyes as she strutted down the hallway. ’Just because the little rat knows how to breach a few high-level World Council bank nodes? It’s so utterly exhausting...’
She scoffed softly, pausing briefly beside a floor-to-ceiling mirror panel to adjust the sharp immaculate white collar of her shirt.

’Now, if this entire bloodbath was a glorious high-stakes competition to see who would get the exclusive right to marry me...’ She tilted her chin, admiring the sharp curve of her jaw and the glint in her eyes. ’Then I would completely understand the massive body count... I would appreciate the effort but an entire colosseum-wide tournament for a shut-in nerd? It’s downright embarrassing.’
She turned away from her reflection, moving briskly toward the private executive elevator.
DING!
The heavy gold-trimmed doors slid open smoothly, revealing a mirrored interior lit with soft amber luminescence.
She stepped inside with her two cybernetic brutes taking position just outside the threshold, snapping to attention like iron statues.
As the doors slowly sealed, a wicked degenerate smirk spread across her dark plum-painted lips.

’You better finish this fast and clean, Onii-chan,’ she thought, her tongue darting out to trace the corner of her mouth with genuine anticipation. ’Because the moment this circus wraps up, I am going to see the actual face of the man who owns that incredibly hot butt...’
She was going to grab it if it was the last thing she did...
HUMMMM!
The elevator dropped with seamless silent speed, carrying her down toward the executive negotiation suite.
Back in the colossal roaring cavern below, the air was thick with the suffocating stench of fresh coppery blood.
High above the pit, hovering on his anti-gravity platform, the Announcer dramatically raised his gold-plated microphone toward the jagged cavern ceiling.
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
A synchronized series of heavy deafening metallic slams echoed across the entire stadium.
Around the perimeter of the circular dirt pit, four massive reinforced steel portcullises built directly into the towering Null-stone foundation began to rise simultaneously.
Heavy industrial chains screamed and ground against rusted iron gears.
SCREEECH... CHUNK!

"LADIES AND DEGENERATES!" the Announcer shrieked into the mic, his magically amplified voice vibrating the concrete bleachers. "THE FOUR PILLARS OF CARNAGE! THE FINAL FOUR SURVIVORS! STEP INTO THE DIRT!"
From the north gate walked Blood-Saint.
The crazed zealot was completely covered in a patchwork of dried, flaking brown gore and fresh wet blood spray.
His tattered priest vestments dragged through the muck, his bare feet sinking deep into the cold mud with wet squelching steps.
Squish! Squish!
His posture was completely disjointed, his neck tilted at an unnatural forty-five-degree angle.
His bloodshot eyes twitched frantically in their sockets, yet a wide blissful grin exposed teeth stained pink with blood.
"He truly looked crazy..."
From the east gate emerged Goliath-9.
THUD! HISS! THUD! HISS!
Every step the nine-foot-tall mechanical monstrosity took physically shook the packed earth.
Hydraulic fluid hissed violently from external pressure valves along his massive titanium-plated thighs.

His right arm was a brutal monolithic marvel of Underworld engineering... a motorized multi-barreled heavy rotary chain-gun, its thick belts of high-caliber ammunition clinking rhythmically against its reinforced ammunition drum.
Clink-clank! Clink-clank!
From the west gate stepped Cyber Ghost.
The Class-A wanted assassin moved with eerie soundless grace.

His matte-black tactical suit was a masterpiece of phased-shift technology as the edges of his silhouette constantly blurred and vibrated light refracting unnaturally off the cloaking modules woven directly into the synthetic fabric.
Beneath his sleek mirrored faceplate, Cyber Ghost’s tactical HUD was already running dozens of calculations per second.
Microscopic lines of green biometric data streamed across his retinas.
[Target 1: Blood-Saint. Threat Level: High (Unstable Biological/Blood Anomaly)]
[Target 2: Goliath-9. Threat Level: Moderate (Heavy Armor/Predictable Trajectory)]
[Target 3: Onii-chan. Threat Level: CRITICAL / UNKNOWN.]

’The cyborg is a walking wall of scrap metal... I can short-circuit his sensory array in four seconds,’ Cyber Ghost analyzed coldly, his fingers twitching above the paired mono-molecular daggers magnetically locked to his hips. ’The priest is a rabid dog, completely driven by instinct but that demon...’
Cyber Ghost’s eyes narrowed behind the one-way visor as his gaze locked onto the south gate.

’The guy in the coat... he didn’t just win his previous rounds. He dismantled physical augments without breaking a sweat. If I let him set the tempo, none of us walk out of this cage. The moment the buzzer hits, I have to take his head before he builds momentum. A synchronized strike will work... Sever the carotid artery, pierce the brainstem through the eye-slit of that ridiculous mask.’
And finally, stepping casually through the south gate... walked Silas.
Crunch! Crunch!
Silas walked with a lazy stride with his heavy combat boots crunching over discarded shell casings and calcified bone fragments.
His hands were buried comfortably deep in the pockets of his dark runic trench coat which he had now decided to wear.
’It’s not like anyone else is wearing the Smart uniforms...’
The silver Oni mask firmly concealed his expression, though the narrow eye slits glowed with a crystalline pale-blue hue.
Silas glanced around the arena, taking in the three killers surrounding him.

’Look at this lineup,’ Silas mused dryly. ’A rabid cultist who desperately needs a shower, a walking toaster with a minigun, and a stealth ninja who probably spent three months practicing his edgy anime pose in front of a bathroom mirror... I just want my identity done and a hot meal. Why do I always have to deal with the theatrics?’
The Announcer hovered his platform directly over the center of the ring, his face dripping with sweat under the harsh stadium spotlights.

"THE RULES ARE ABSOLUTE!" the Announcer’s voice roared through the PA. "GRAVELY WOUND, DISMEMBER, OR SEND YOUR OPPONENTS STRAIGHT TO HELL! THE LAST MAN STANDING IN THIS PIT WILL BE CROWNED THE UNDISPUTED CHAMPION OF SHOGITOWN!"
CLANG!
Behind each of the four combatants, the steel portcullises dropped like guillotines, sealing into the bedrock with massive locking bolts.
BZZZZZZZZT!
The towering perimeter of Null-stone pillars flared with an ominous deep-blue electrical luminescence.
The anti-magic suppression field settled over the arena like a crushing gravitational blanket.
The ambient mana in the air turned completely dormant, suffocating any attempt at external spellcasting.
The four fighters settled into a wide tense square as the stadium fell deathly quiet and thousands of spectators leaned over the railings, their breath caught in their throats.
"THREE!"
Goliath-9’s rotary barrels began to rotate with a low rising hum.
Vrrrrr...
"TWO!"
Cyber Ghost lowered his stance, the light bending around his boots as his phase modules primed.
"ONE!"
Blood-Saint let out a low guttural growl that sounded like tearing wet leather.
"BEGIN!"
BEEEEEEEEEP!
The buzzer barely finished echoing off the cavern ceiling before Cyber Ghost executed his plan.
SHIIIING! WHOOSH!
With a terrifying burst of cybernetic acceleration, Cyber Ghost broke across the dirt.
He didn’t waste a millisecond as his cloaking field shifted into overdrive, turning him into a translucent distorted blur of dark energy.
In less than a tenth of a second, he was directly in Silas’s blind spot, rising like a wraith from the dust.
His right hand blurred, drawing the glowing blue mono-molecular dagger from his hip.
The blade hummed with high-frequency vibrations capable of shearing through tank armor.
’Die, you arrogant bastard!’ Cyber Ghost screamed internally, driving the tip of the vibrating dagger straight toward the exposed side of Silas’s neck.
Silas didn’t even flinch as his hands remained firmly wedged inside his coat pockets.
He didn’t need to move.
SWOOOOOSH... BAM!
From across the ring, a feral blood-soaked projectile violently intercepted the assassin.

Blood-Saint had launched himself through the air like a rabid animal, his body twisting mid-flight to deliver a devastating accelerated flying roundhouse kick straight into Cyber Ghost’s exposed flank.
CRACK-THUD!
"GHK—?!" Cyber Ghost’s optical sensors flared blinding red with error warnings.
The raw force of the kick hit him like a freight train. In a desperate bid for survival, the assassin tapped his belt module.
FZZZT!
His physical molecular structure instantly dispersed into an ethereal cloud of semi-translucent gas, allowing the majority of the blunt force trauma to pass through him.
Yet the shockwave still caught his physical anchor.
SKRRRRRRT!
Cyber Ghost was launched sixty feet across the arena floor with his boots rematerializing just in time to dig deep smoking trenches into the packed dirt before he slammed against the cage wall.
He dropped to one knee, coughing up a mouthful of thick metallic-tasting saliva.
"Gah... What the hell..."
He glared up through his cracked visor, his voice shaking with pure fury.

"Why the fuck did you attack me, you raving lunatic?!" Cyber Ghost snarled, pointing his vibrating dagger at the priest. "Are you blind?! Onii-chan is clearly the biggest threat on the field right now! If we don’t jump him together, we’re all dead!"
Blood-Saint didn’t even turn his head toward the assassin.
His twisted bloodshot eyes were entirely, obsessively locked onto the silver Oni mask.
A thin line of crimson drool dripped from his chin, sizzling against the dirt.

"This is a sacred pit... a holy royale," Blood-Saint whispered, his voice rising from a wet rasp into a shriek. "And Onii-chan is going to be my feast! My god demands his flesh! I won’t let a rat soil my holy offering!"
Blood-Saint dropped onto all fours with his spine popping sickeningly as he kicked off the earth, charging directly at Silas once more.
TAP-TAP-TAP-TAP!
"I’LL RIP YOUR HEART FROM YOUR RIBS AND SWALLOW IT WHOLE!" Blood-Saint screamed, his fingers hardening into jagged blood-encrusted claws.
Silas stood perfectly still, watching the crazed zealot sprint toward him.

’Great. Another screaming cultist...’ Silas thought with a groan. ’Why does nobody ever attack politely? Just once, I’d like a villain to hand me a formal notice of duel instead of shouting about eating my internal organs.’
However, before Blood-Saint’s claws could reach Silas’s chest—
WHIRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR!
A deafening mechanical roar drowned out the entire colosseum.
Goliath-9 stepped forward, the ground trembling beneath his massive steel chassis.
The multi-barreled rotary chain-gun on his right arm reached maximum rotational velocity, the six heavy barrels blurring into a solid steel cylinder of imminent slaughter.
"MULTIPLE HOSTILES DETECTED," the cyborg’s voice boomed from his internal chest amplifiers. "INITIATING MAXIMUM ERADICATION."
BRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRT!
A blinding continuous wall of golden muzzle flash erupted from the gun’s muzzle.
The heavy rotary cannon spit over four thousand rounds of high-explosive armor-piercing ammunition per minute.
The sound wasn’t a series of individual gunshots... it was a continuous, ripping roar like a sheet of canvas being torn in half by a god.
TH-TH-TH-TH-TH-TH-TH-TH-THOOM!
The massive thumb-sized lead slugs violently tore the packed dirt of the arena floor to ribbons.
Mud, pulverized stone, and shrapnel exploded upward in a dense blinding storm of particulate matter.
High above the slaughter, perched on the dark steel catwalks suspended beneath the cavern roof.
One of the Syndicate’s elite snipers adjusted the magnification on his thermal-imaging rifle scope.
He watched the massive wall of lead chew through the dirt below with his jaw dropping slightly behind his ballistic balaclava.
He keyed his internal helmet comms.

"Uh, team lead... check camera four," the sniper muttered hesitantly. "Is that... is that actually legal down there? That’s a literal military-grade rotary autocannon. Rule number two of the cage explicitly bans external heavy ordinance after all."

sentences.text: She already had a completely clear idea of exactly who would walk out of that pit alive.
’Of course it’ll be him...’
From the reinforced security booth perched just beneath the mid-tier VIP promenade, the receptionist adjusted the cuff of her charcoal-black tailored blazer.
Through the heavy polarized safety glass, the colosseum looked like a churning cauldron of filth, blood, and flashing neon wagers.
Down in that dirt, men died for pocket change and a few scraps of glory.
’I’ve watched everything... and I can’t say I’m disappointed.’𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎

She had watched the Demon in the silver Oni mask, the lunatic calling himself Onii-chan, completely defy the established laws of physics, crushing bone density and reinforced steel alike with the casual indifference of a man swatting a mosquito.
The other three fighters scheduled to step through those gates were dead men walking.
They just hadn’t received their official death certificates yet.

And so, as the legitimate blood-born daughter of the Boss of the Black-Ash Syndicate, she would legally need to be present for the final asset negotiations regarding her runaway degenerate hacker brother.
’I wonder why Onii-chan wants him so much though...’
PSSH-T!
She tapped the hydraulic override switch on the security panel, and the heavy steel door to her booth hissed open.
The moment she stepped out into the carpeted private corridor, she was flanked instantly by two massive hulking cybernetic bodyguards.
Their pneumatic joints hissed with every step with their heavy armor plates grinding together beneath broad synthetic trench coats.
Click!
Clack!
Click!
Clack!
Her high heels made sharp taps against the plush deep-crimson carpeting of the executive promenade.
"Haah..."

’Why the hell does this whole massive bloody event have to be about that greasy fucker Jax?’ she thought, rolling her dark kohl-rimmed eyes as she strutted down the hallway. ’Just because the little rat knows how to breach a few high-level World Council bank nodes?
It’s so utterly exhausting...’
She scoffed softly, pausing briefly beside a floor-to-ceiling mirror panel to adjust the sharp immaculate white collar of her shirt.

’Now, if this entire bloodbath was a glorious high-stakes competition to see who would get the exclusive right to marry me...’ She tilted her chin, admiring the sharp curve of her jaw and the glint in her eyes. ’Then I would completely understand the massive body count...
I would appreciate the effort but an entire colosseum-wide tournament for a shut-in nerd?
It’s downright embarrassing.’
She turned away from her reflection, moving briskly toward the private executive elevator.
DING!
The heavy gold-trimmed doors slid open smoothly, revealing a mirrored interior lit with soft amber luminescence.
She stepped inside with her two cybernetic brutes taking position just outside the threshold, snapping to attention like iron statues.
As the doors slowly sealed, a wicked degenerate smirk spread across her dark plum-painted lips.

’You better finish this fast and clean, Onii-chan,’ she thought, her tongue darting out to trace the corner of her mouth with genuine anticipation. ’Because the moment this circus wraps up, I am going to see the actual face of the man who owns that incredibly hot butt...’
She was going to grab it if it was the last thing she did...
HUMMMM!
The elevator dropped with seamless silent speed, carrying her down toward the executive negotiation suite.
Back in the colossal roaring cavern below, the air was thick with the suffocating stench of fresh coppery blood.
High above the pit, hovering on his anti-gravity platform, the Announcer dramatically raised his gold-plated microphone toward the jagged cavern ceiling.
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
A synchronized series of heavy deafening metallic slams echoed across the entire stadium.
Around the perimeter of the circular dirt pit, four massive reinforced steel portcullises built directly into the towering Null-stone foundation began to rise simultaneously.
Heavy industrial chains screamed and ground against rusted iron gears.
SCREEECH...
CHUNK!
"LADIES AND DEGENERATES!" the Announcer shrieked into the mic, his magically amplified voice vibrating the concrete bleachers.
"THE FOUR PILLARS OF CARNAGE!
THE FINAL FOUR SURVIVORS!
STEP INTO THE DIRT!"
From the north gate walked Blood-Saint.
The crazed zealot was completely covered in a patchwork of dried, flaking brown gore and fresh wet blood spray.
His tattered priest vestments dragged through the muck, his bare feet sinking deep into the cold mud with wet squelching steps.
Squish!
Squish!
His posture was completely disjointed, his neck tilted at an unnatural forty-five-degree angle.
His bloodshot eyes twitched frantically in their sockets, yet a wide blissful grin exposed teeth stained pink with blood.
"He truly looked crazy..."
From the east gate emerged Goliath-9.
THUD!
HISS!
THUD!
HISS!
Every step the nine-foot-tall mechanical monstrosity took physically shook the packed earth.
Hydraulic fluid hissed violently from external pressure valves along his massive titanium-plated thighs.

His right arm was a brutal monolithic marvel of Underworld engineering... a motorized multi-barreled heavy rotary chain-gun, its thick belts of high-caliber ammunition clinking rhythmically against its reinforced ammunition drum.
Clink-clank!
Clink-clank!
From the west gate stepped Cyber Ghost.
The Class-A wanted assassin moved with eerie soundless grace.

His matte-black tactical suit was a masterpiece of phased-shift technology as the edges of his silhouette constantly blurred and vibrated light refracting unnaturally off the cloaking modules woven directly into the synthetic fabric.
Beneath his sleek mirrored faceplate, Cyber Ghost’s tactical HUD was already running dozens of calculations per second.
Microscopic lines of green biometric data streamed across his retinas.
[Target 1: Blood-Saint.
Threat Level: High (Unstable Biological/Blood Anomaly)]
[Target 2: Goliath-9.
Threat Level: Moderate (Heavy Armor/Predictable Trajectory)]
[Target 3: Onii-chan.
Threat Level: CRITICAL / UNKNOWN.]
’The cyborg is a walking wall of scrap metal...

I can short-circuit his sensory array in four seconds,’ Cyber Ghost analyzed coldly, his fingers twitching above the paired mono-molecular daggers magnetically locked to his hips. ’The priest is a rabid dog, completely driven by instinct but that demon...’
Cyber Ghost’s eyes narrowed behind the one-way visor as his gaze locked onto the south gate.
’The guy in the coat... he didn’t just win his previous rounds.
He dismantled physical augments without breaking a sweat.
If I let him set the tempo, none of us walk out of this cage.
The moment the buzzer hits, I have to take his head before he builds momentum.
A synchronized strike will work...
Sever the carotid artery, pierce the brainstem through the eye-slit of that ridiculous mask.’
And finally, stepping casually through the south gate... walked Silas.
Crunch!
Crunch!
Silas walked with a lazy stride with his heavy combat boots crunching over discarded shell casings and calcified bone fragments.
His hands were buried comfortably deep in the pockets of his dark runic trench coat which he had now decided to wear.
’It’s not like anyone else is wearing the Smart uniforms...’
The silver Oni mask firmly concealed his expression, though the narrow eye slits glowed with a crystalline pale-blue hue.
Silas glanced around the arena, taking in the three killers surrounding him.

’Look at this lineup,’ Silas mused dryly. ’A rabid cultist who desperately needs a shower, a walking toaster with a minigun, and a stealth ninja who probably spent three months practicing his edgy anime pose in front of a bathroom mirror...
I just want my identity done and a hot meal.
Why do I always have to deal with the theatrics?’
The Announcer hovered his platform directly over the center of the ring, his face dripping with sweat under the harsh stadium spotlights.
"THE RULES ARE ABSOLUTE!" the Announcer’s voice roared through the PA.
"GRAVELY WOUND, DISMEMBER, OR SEND YOUR OPPONENTS STRAIGHT TO HELL!
THE LAST MAN STANDING IN THIS PIT WILL BE CROWNED THE UNDISPUTED CHAMPION OF SHOGITOWN!"
CLANG!
Behind each of the four combatants, the steel portcullises dropped like guillotines, sealing into the bedrock with massive locking bolts.
BZZZZZZZZT!
The towering perimeter of Null-stone pillars flared with an ominous deep-blue electrical luminescence.
The anti-magic suppression field settled over the arena like a crushing gravitational blanket.
The ambient mana in the air turned completely dormant, suffocating any attempt at external spellcasting.
The four fighters settled into a wide tense square as the stadium fell deathly quiet and thousands of spectators leaned over the railings, their breath caught in their throats.
"THREE!"
Goliath-9’s rotary barrels began to rotate with a low rising hum.
Vrrrrr...
"TWO!"
Cyber Ghost lowered his stance, the light bending around his boots as his phase modules primed.
"ONE!"
Blood-Saint let out a low guttural growl that sounded like tearing wet leather.
"BEGIN!"
BEEEEEEEEEP!
The buzzer barely finished echoing off the cavern ceiling before Cyber Ghost executed his plan.
SHIIIING!
WHOOSH!
With a terrifying burst of cybernetic acceleration, Cyber Ghost broke across the dirt.
He didn’t waste a millisecond as his cloaking field shifted into overdrive, turning him into a translucent distorted blur of dark energy.
In less than a tenth of a second, he was directly in Silas’s blind spot, rising like a wraith from the dust.
His right hand blurred, drawing the glowing blue mono-molecular dagger from his hip.
The blade hummed with high-frequency vibrations capable of shearing through tank armor.
’Die, you arrogant bastard!’ Cyber Ghost screamed internally, driving the tip of the vibrating dagger straight toward the exposed side of Silas’s neck.
Silas didn’t even flinch as his hands remained firmly wedged inside his coat pockets.
He didn’t need to move.
SWOOOOOSH...
BAM!
From across the ring, a feral blood-soaked projectile violently intercepted the assassin.

Blood-Saint had launched himself through the air like a rabid animal, his body twisting mid-flight to deliver a devastating accelerated flying roundhouse kick straight into Cyber Ghost’s exposed flank.
CRACK-THUD!
"GHK—?!" Cyber Ghost’s optical sensors flared blinding red with error warnings.
The raw force of the kick hit him like a freight train.
In a desperate bid for survival, the assassin tapped his belt module.
FZZZT!
His physical molecular structure instantly dispersed into an ethereal cloud of semi-translucent gas, allowing the majority of the blunt force trauma to pass through him.
Yet the shockwave still caught his physical anchor.
SKRRRRRRT!
Cyber Ghost was launched sixty feet across the arena floor with his boots rematerializing just in time to dig deep smoking trenches into the packed dirt before he slammed against the cage wall.
He dropped to one knee, coughing up a mouthful of thick metallic-tasting saliva.
"Gah...
What the hell..."
