chapters.title: Chapter 370: The Final Round [II / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: CLANG!
The veteran sniper team leader standing beside him didn’t even hesitate as he violently slammed the heavy steel-reinforced butt of his own rifle directly against the side of the rookie’s helmet.
"Ow! What the hell?!"

"Shut your damn mouth and watch your firing sector, you idiot!" the team leader barked harshly. "Look at his shoulder housing! The weapon feed is hard-wired directly into his synthetic spinal column! It’s a biological-cybernetic implant, not an external weapon! The Boss approved his schematics yesterday! Now shut up and scan for rogue mana surges!"
Down in the dirt pit, the arena was a slaughterhouse of flying metal.
PING-PING-PING-PING-PING!
"AHHHHHHHHHHH!"
Blood-Saint shrieked in rage as the heavy stream of lead bore down on him.
Even with his hyper-accelerated reflexes, the density of the firing cone made evasion mathematically impossible.
CRUNCH!
Without a second thought, Blood-Saint bit down violently on his own left thumb, completely severing the flesh to the bone.
SPLURT!
A massive volume of dark pressurized blood erupted from the wound and Blood-Saint caught the fluid in his palm and violently swept his arm outward.
"Hehehehee...."
HISSSS... CLACK!
The blood ignited with mana that was already stored in it.
Defying the laws of physics, the fluid instantly solidified mid-air into a dense crimson tower shield of hyper-crystallized iron.
D-D-D-D-D-D-D-DANG!
The heavy armor-piercing rounds slammed into the blood-shield with deafening metallic rings, sending red sparks cascading across the mud, slowly chipping away at the dense barrier.
Across the ring, Cyber Ghost let out a sharp mocking laugh over his external speakers.
"Primitive brute," Cyber Ghost sneered.
BZZZZT!
He hit the primary dial on his phase-shift belt and his entire body flickered violently, dissolving completely into a translucent, dark gray silhouette of pure gas.
SWOOSH-SWOOSH-SWOOSH!

The dense barrage of supersonic ammunition tore harmlessly straight through the gaseous cloud, passing through his non-corporeal form without transferring an ounce of energy, sparking uselessly against the reinforced Null-stone pillars behind him.
And in the center of the crossfire... stood Silas.
He didn’t summon a blood shield and he didn’t phase into high-tech gas either... because he couldn’t, however the audience was waiting to see what the legendary man would be able to pull off.
"GO, ONII-CHAN! I BET ALL OF MY MONEY ON YOU!"
"FUCKING MOVE ALREADY!"
Silas simply inhaled a slow breath.
Shhhhh!
Beneath the silver metal of his Oni mask, the pale glow in his eyes flared into the razor-sharp brilliance of his Rip-Current Perception.
To Silas, the world around him became slow as though he was in water.
The deafening roar of the minigun turned into a deep bass-heavy pulse.

The clouds of pulverized dust hung suspended in mid-air like static constellations and the thousands of high-velocity lead slugs tore through the space before him at the agonizingly slow pace of drifting dandelion seeds.
Silas saw the exact rifling spin on every single bullet.
He saw the microscopic trajectories, the intersecting shockwaves, and the precise paper-thin lanes of empty space weaving between the volley.
’I really have to thank Morwenna for all of this.’ Silas thought, he couldn’t wait to show her how much he had grown too, who knew? Maybe this time, he would be the one to grab her ass.

Silas kept both hands buried comfortably in his trench coat pockets as he simply strolled forward through the bullet storm with the casual fluid grace of a man taking a Sunday walk through a light drizzle.
Sway!
He leaned his upper torso two inches to the left as a massive armor-piercing slug screamed past his right cheek, the sonic crack rustling the collar of his coat.
Step!
He pivoted his hips slightly to the right. Three heavy rounds passed cleanly through the four-inch gap between his arm and his ribs.
Tilt!
He tilted his head back half an inch as a stray bullet grazed the bottom lip of his silver demon mask.
SHHHH!
A bright orange spark flashed against the metal, but Silas didn’t even blink.
He continued walking, weaving effortlessly through a lethal wall of lead that would have shredded an entire infantry division to minced meat.
Up on the floating platform, the Announcer nearly choked on his own tongue.
"H-HE’S JUST WALKING THROUGH IT! HE ISN’T EVEN DODGING, HE’S JUST... WALKING!"
Goliath-9’s internal combat processor suffered a catastrophic error.
[ALERT: TARGET EVASION EXCEEDS PROBABILITY CALCULATIONS BY 99.8%... RE-ROUTING TARGETING ALGORITHMS]
The massive cyborg realized his primary weapon was completely useless against the anomaly in the trench coat as he couldn’t track the man’s micro-movements.
"ADAPTING..." Goliath-9 boomed.

The heavy hydraulic joints in his torso screamed as he violently swung the roaring rotary cannon away from Silas, aiming the full fury of the lead storm straight at the dark gas cloud where Cyber Ghost was hovering.
"SECONDARY TARGET MARKED FOR TERMINATION."
Goliath-9’s left shoulder plate snapped open with a sharp mechanical click.
THUMP!
A high-yield electromagnetic pulse canister launched from his shoulder mortar, arcing straight into the center of the translucent gas cloud.
"Oh, you piece of rusted shit—" Cyber Ghost’s panicked voice crackled through the air.
KRA-BZZZZZZZZT!
The EMP grenade detonated mid-air as a blinding dome of crackling blue electrical energy ripped through the space.
The intense electromagnetic pulse fried the delicate phase-inversion circuits lining Cyber Ghost’s tactical suit as the cloaking field collapsed with a violent shower of blue sparks.
THUD!
Cyber Ghost was forcibly ripped out of his gaseous state with his solid flesh and bone materializing heavily onto the cold dirt.
’System failure? Auxiliary power offline?’ Cyber Ghost thought with his muscles locking up from the feedback.
Before the assassin could even raise his daggers to defend himself, nine feet of solid hydraulic-driven steel closed the distance.
BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!
Goliath-9 arrived like an avalanche. The massive cyborg pulled his heavy reinforced hydraulic left fist back with the pistons hissing as they reached maximum compression.
CRACK-THUUUUMP!
Goliath-9 drove his massive metal fist directly into the center of Cyber Ghost’s chest.
"GURGH—!"
The sound of shattering bone was sickeningly loud.
Cyber Ghost’s reinforced carbon-fiber chest plate caved in entirely, snapping his sternum and splintering six of his ribs.
The power launched the assassin forty feet through the air like a ragdoll.
Cyber Ghost skipped across the mud, rolling violently until he crashed into the base of the arena wall.
"Gah!"
He lay there in the dirt, coughing up thick dark blood with his suit sparking and smoking. He was barely clinging to consciousness, paralyzed from the chest down.
Goliath-9 stomped forward, raising a massive spiked titanium boot to crush the assassin’s head into paste.
"TERMINATING SECONDARY TARGE—"
"NOT BEFORE ME, YOU BUCKET OF BOLTS!"
A feral shriek echoed from above.
SWOOSH!
Blood-Saint dropped out of the sky like a predatory bird.
He completely abandoned his shattered blood shield and landed directly onto Goliath-9’s massive shoulders with his bare feet locking around the cyborg’s neck casing.
SPLAT!
Blood-Saint didn’t use a blade.
He coated his bare hands in a thick layer of acidic pressurized blood, driving his fingers straight into the exposed brass exhaust pipes bolted to the cyborg’s mechanical spine.
HISSSSSSS!
"LET’S SEE HOW MUCH BLOOD IS INSIDE THIS TOY!" Blood-Saint roared, his back muscles bulging with unnatural power as he yanked backward.
SCREEECH... SNAP!

With terrifying mana-fueled strength, Blood-Saint literally ripped the heavy industrial exhaust assembly completely out of the cyborg’s back, tearing steel brackets and high-pressure hydraulic lines like wet cardboard.
PSSSSSSSSSH-BOOM!
Scalding hot pressurized white steam erupted violently from the ruined spinal housing.
"CRITICAL SYSTEM DAMAGE! HYDRAULIC PRESSURE DROPPING!" Goliath-9’s voice synthesizer glitched violently.
The massive machine stumbled, flailing wildly as it spun in circles to dislodge the manic priest from its back.
Across the pit, Silas stopped his leisurely stroll.
He looked at the chaotic messy brawl happening ten yards away.

’Look at this mess,’ Silas thought, shaking his head with annoyance. ’Torn metal, screaming cultists, hydraulic fluid spraying everywhere. If they keep this up, they’re going to get grease all over my clean trench coat.’
He wasn’t usually like this but he was annoyed about this, he wanted to get it over with as soon as possible.
Silas took his hands out of his pockets.
FZZT!
Silas simply engaged a tiny fraction of his Gold Core’s output, folding the space between them in an imperceptible burst of acceleration.
To the audience, he simply vanished from existence.
WHISH!
Silas reappeared directly in front of the flailing nine-foot-tall Goliath-9, planted firmly inside the cyborg’s immediate reach.
Goliath-9’s optical sensors flared frantically.
[PROXIMITY WARNING! PROXIMITY WARNING!]

Even with his back ruined, the cyborg’s combat reflexes took over. Goliath-9 brought his massive red-hot rotary chain-gun arm sweeping downward in a vicious bone-crushing arc aimed straight at Silas’s head, intending to turn the man into red mist with twenty tons of hydraulic force.
"Heh."
However Silas didn’t duck as he simply raised his open left hand.
CLANG-THUUUUM!
Silas caught the massive red-hot six-barrel assembly completely bare-handed.
SCREEEEEEECH!
The overwhelming momentum of the cyborg’s swing ground against the reinforced leather of Silas’s black glove.
Blinding orange and white sparks erupted outward in a fountain, the friction screaming loud enough to drown out the crowd.
Yet Silas didn’t move an inch. His feet remained planted in the mud like massive iron pillars driven into the bedrock of the earth.
Goliath-9’s internal servos whined in mechanical horror.
[ERROR! TARGET MASS IS IMMOVABLE! HYDRAULIC PRESSURE IS OVERLOADING!]
"WHAT... ARE... YOU?" the cyborg’s synthetic voice glitched, desperately trying to pull the heavy arm back but it wouldn’t budge.
Silas’s grip held the massive weapon with the unyielding permanence of a mountain.
Silas slowly tilted his head up, looking directly into the glowing red slit of the machine’s optical visor.
CRUNCH!
With a single effortless flex of his fingers, Silas closed his fist.
The heavy titanium-alloy barrels of the rotary cannon crumpled inward like cheap aluminum foil, completely crushing the internal firing pins and shattering the motorized housing.
"You’re very..." Silas replied coldly through his Oni mask. "Dissapointing."
Silas pulled his right fist back, coiling the muscles in his shoulder like a massive steel spring.

He focused a dense compressed pulse of internal force directly into the heel of his palm and then Silas stepped forward and drove a clean devastating Palm Strike straight into the dead center of Goliath-9’s heavily reinforced titanium chest plating.
KRA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The sound wasn’t a standard metallic thud. It was a concussive thunderclap that blasted the loose dirt away in a thirty-foot shockwave.
The physical kinetic force didn’t waste its energy denting the heavy outer armor...

Through the terrifying mastery of Silas’s mana, the shockwave bypassed the three-inch-thick steel plating, transmitting the full destructive force straight into the delicate, pressurized life-support chamber suspended deep within the machine’s core.
Inside that steel vault... the small biological human heart that kept the cyborg alive violently, instantly ruptured from the hydrostatic shock.
Splat!
Goliath-9’s entire nine-foot frame instantly went rigid.
The blinding red light in his optical visor flickered erratically for half a second.
Bzzzt... click!
The light died.

The massive multi-ton mechanical titan went completely limp as the pneumatic pressure dropped with a dying hiss, and the monolithic cyborg collapsed backward into the dirt like a falling skyscraper, shaking the entire arena with a massive thud.
Blood-Saint, who had still been clinging to the machine’s ruined spine, was thrown violently through the air by the backblast.
"FUCKKKKK!"
SPLASH!
The priest landed hard in a pool of bloody mud twenty feet away, rolling to his feet with a wet ragged gasp.
Silas didn’t even look at the dead cyborg as he slowly turned his masked head to the side.
At the edge of the cage, Cyber Ghost was desperately trying to drag himself toward the reinforced gate.
He was using his bleeding elbows, his useless, broken legs trailing behind him in the mud.
He looked back over his shoulder with his shattered visor reflecting the terrifying silhouette of the man in the trench coat.
"P-Please..." Cyber Ghost wheezed, blood bubbling past his lips. "I yield... I forfeit the match—"𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
Silas walked over to him with calm steps as he didn’t bother offering a cool one-liner.
Silas simply raised his right combat boot and delivered a single heavy kick squarely to the side of the assassin’s temple.
THWACK!
Cyber Ghost’s head whipped violently to the side, his neck snapping with a clean dull pop.
His eyes rolled back into his skull, and the assassin went completely limp, collapsing face-first into the mud.
He wasn’t dead, but his brain had been thoroughly rattled into a deep, concussive coma.
He was officially out of the tournament.
The massive chaotic four-way Royale had just been cleanly reduced to a simple one-on-one which was between Onii-Chan and Blood Saint.
"ONIIIIIIII-CHANNNNNNNNNNNNN!"

sentences.text: CLANG!
The veteran sniper team leader standing beside him didn’t even hesitate as he violently slammed the heavy steel-reinforced butt of his own rifle directly against the side of the rookie’s helmet.
"Ow!
What the hell?!"
"Shut your damn mouth and watch your firing sector, you idiot!" the team leader barked harshly.
"Look at his shoulder housing!
The weapon feed is hard-wired directly into his synthetic spinal column!
It’s a biological-cybernetic implant, not an external weapon!
The Boss approved his schematics yesterday!
Now shut up and scan for rogue mana surges!"
Down in the dirt pit, the arena was a slaughterhouse of flying metal.
PING-PING-PING-PING-PING!
"AHHHHHHHHHHH!"
Blood-Saint shrieked in rage as the heavy stream of lead bore down on him.
Even with his hyper-accelerated reflexes, the density of the firing cone made evasion mathematically impossible.
CRUNCH!
Without a second thought, Blood-Saint bit down violently on his own left thumb, completely severing the flesh to the bone.
SPLURT!
A massive volume of dark pressurized blood erupted from the wound and Blood-Saint caught the fluid in his palm and violently swept his arm outward.
"Hehehehee...."
HISSSS...
CLACK!
The blood ignited with mana that was already stored in it.
Defying the laws of physics, the fluid instantly solidified mid-air into a dense crimson tower shield of hyper-crystallized iron.
D-D-D-D-D-D-D-DANG!
The heavy armor-piercing rounds slammed into the blood-shield with deafening metallic rings, sending red sparks cascading across the mud, slowly chipping away at the dense barrier.
Across the ring, Cyber Ghost let out a sharp mocking laugh over his external speakers.
"Primitive brute," Cyber Ghost sneered.
BZZZZT!
He hit the primary dial on his phase-shift belt and his entire body flickered violently, dissolving completely into a translucent, dark gray silhouette of pure gas.
SWOOSH-SWOOSH-SWOOSH!

The dense barrage of supersonic ammunition tore harmlessly straight through the gaseous cloud, passing through his non-corporeal form without transferring an ounce of energy, sparking uselessly against the reinforced Null-stone pillars behind him.
And in the center of the crossfire... stood Silas.
He didn’t summon a blood shield and he didn’t phase into high-tech gas either... because he couldn’t, however the audience was waiting to see what the legendary man would be able to pull off.
"GO, ONII-CHAN!
I BET ALL OF MY MONEY ON YOU!"
"FUCKING MOVE ALREADY!"
Silas simply inhaled a slow breath.
Shhhhh!
Beneath the silver metal of his Oni mask, the pale glow in his eyes flared into the razor-sharp brilliance of his Rip-Current Perception.
To Silas, the world around him became slow as though he was in water.
The deafening roar of the minigun turned into a deep bass-heavy pulse.

The clouds of pulverized dust hung suspended in mid-air like static constellations and the thousands of high-velocity lead slugs tore through the space before him at the agonizingly slow pace of drifting dandelion seeds.
Silas saw the exact rifling spin on every single bullet.
He saw the microscopic trajectories, the intersecting shockwaves, and the precise paper-thin lanes of empty space weaving between the volley.
’I really have to thank Morwenna for all of this.’ Silas thought, he couldn’t wait to show her how much he had grown too, who knew?
Maybe this time, he would be the one to grab her ass.

Silas kept both hands buried comfortably in his trench coat pockets as he simply strolled forward through the bullet storm with the casual fluid grace of a man taking a Sunday walk through a light drizzle.
Sway!
He leaned his upper torso two inches to the left as a massive armor-piercing slug screamed past his right cheek, the sonic crack rustling the collar of his coat.
Step!
He pivoted his hips slightly to the right.
Three heavy rounds passed cleanly through the four-inch gap between his arm and his ribs.
Tilt!
He tilted his head back half an inch as a stray bullet grazed the bottom lip of his silver demon mask.
SHHHH!
A bright orange spark flashed against the metal, but Silas didn’t even blink.
He continued walking, weaving effortlessly through a lethal wall of lead that would have shredded an entire infantry division to minced meat.
Up on the floating platform, the Announcer nearly choked on his own tongue.
"H-HE’S JUST WALKING THROUGH IT!
HE ISN’T EVEN DODGING, HE’S JUST...
WALKING!"
Goliath-9’s internal combat processor suffered a catastrophic error.
[ALERT: TARGET EVASION EXCEEDS PROBABILITY CALCULATIONS BY 99.8%...
RE-ROUTING TARGETING ALGORITHMS]
The massive cyborg realized his primary weapon was completely useless against the anomaly in the trench coat as he couldn’t track the man’s micro-movements.
"ADAPTING..." Goliath-9 boomed.

The heavy hydraulic joints in his torso screamed as he violently swung the roaring rotary cannon away from Silas, aiming the full fury of the lead storm straight at the dark gas cloud where Cyber Ghost was hovering.
"SECONDARY TARGET MARKED FOR TERMINATION."
Goliath-9’s left shoulder plate snapped open with a sharp mechanical click.
THUMP!
A high-yield electromagnetic pulse canister launched from his shoulder mortar, arcing straight into the center of the translucent gas cloud.
"Oh, you piece of rusted shit—" Cyber Ghost’s panicked voice crackled through the air.
KRA-BZZZZZZZZT!
The EMP grenade detonated mid-air as a blinding dome of crackling blue electrical energy ripped through the space.
The intense electromagnetic pulse fried the delicate phase-inversion circuits lining Cyber Ghost’s tactical suit as the cloaking field collapsed with a violent shower of blue sparks.
THUD!
Cyber Ghost was forcibly ripped out of his gaseous state with his solid flesh and bone materializing heavily onto the cold dirt.
’System failure?
Auxiliary power offline?’ Cyber Ghost thought with his muscles locking up from the feedback.
Before the assassin could even raise his daggers to defend himself, nine feet of solid hydraulic-driven steel closed the distance.
BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!
Goliath-9 arrived like an avalanche.
The massive cyborg pulled his heavy reinforced hydraulic left fist back with the pistons hissing as they reached maximum compression.
CRACK-THUUUUMP!
Goliath-9 drove his massive metal fist directly into the center of Cyber Ghost’s chest.
"GURGH—!"
The sound of shattering bone was sickeningly loud.
Cyber Ghost’s reinforced carbon-fiber chest plate caved in entirely, snapping his sternum and splintering six of his ribs.
The power launched the assassin forty feet through the air like a ragdoll.
Cyber Ghost skipped across the mud, rolling violently until he crashed into the base of the arena wall.
"Gah!"
He lay there in the dirt, coughing up thick dark blood with his suit sparking and smoking.
He was barely clinging to consciousness, paralyzed from the chest down.
Goliath-9 stomped forward, raising a massive spiked titanium boot to crush the assassin’s head into paste.
"TERMINATING SECONDARY TARGE—"
"NOT BEFORE ME, YOU BUCKET OF BOLTS!"
A feral shriek echoed from above.
SWOOSH!
Blood-Saint dropped out of the sky like a predatory bird.
He completely abandoned his shattered blood shield and landed directly onto Goliath-9’s massive shoulders with his bare feet locking around the cyborg’s neck casing.
SPLAT!
Blood-Saint didn’t use a blade.
He coated his bare hands in a thick layer of acidic pressurized blood, driving his fingers straight into the exposed brass exhaust pipes bolted to the cyborg’s mechanical spine.
HISSSSSSS!
"LET’S SEE HOW MUCH BLOOD IS INSIDE THIS TOY!" Blood-Saint roared, his back muscles bulging with unnatural power as he yanked backward.
SCREEECH...
SNAP!

With terrifying mana-fueled strength, Blood-Saint literally ripped the heavy industrial exhaust assembly completely out of the cyborg’s back, tearing steel brackets and high-pressure hydraulic lines like wet cardboard.
PSSSSSSSSSH-BOOM!
Scalding hot pressurized white steam erupted violently from the ruined spinal housing.
"CRITICAL SYSTEM DAMAGE!
HYDRAULIC PRESSURE DROPPING!" Goliath-9’s voice synthesizer glitched violently.
The massive machine stumbled, flailing wildly as it spun in circles to dislodge the manic priest from its back.
Across the pit, Silas stopped his leisurely stroll.
He looked at the chaotic messy brawl happening ten yards away.
’Look at this mess,’ Silas thought, shaking his head with annoyance. ’Torn metal, screaming cultists, hydraulic fluid spraying everywhere.
If they keep this up, they’re going to get grease all over my clean trench coat.’
He wasn’t usually like this but he was annoyed about this, he wanted to get it over with as soon as possible.
Silas took his hands out of his pockets.
FZZT!
Silas simply engaged a tiny fraction of his Gold Core’s output, folding the space between them in an imperceptible burst of acceleration.
To the audience, he simply vanished from existence.
WHISH!
Silas reappeared directly in front of the flailing nine-foot-tall Goliath-9, planted firmly inside the cyborg’s immediate reach.
Goliath-9’s optical sensors flared frantically.
[PROXIMITY WARNING!
PROXIMITY WARNING!]
Even with his back ruined, the cyborg’s combat reflexes took over.

Goliath-9 brought his massive red-hot rotary chain-gun arm sweeping downward in a vicious bone-crushing arc aimed straight at Silas’s head, intending to turn the man into red mist with twenty tons of hydraulic force.
"Heh."
However Silas didn’t duck as he simply raised his open left hand.
CLANG-THUUUUM!
Silas caught the massive red-hot six-barrel assembly completely bare-handed.
SCREEEEEEECH!
The overwhelming momentum of the cyborg’s swing ground against the reinforced leather of Silas’s black glove.
Blinding orange and white sparks erupted outward in a fountain, the friction screaming loud enough to drown out the crowd.
Yet Silas didn’t move an inch.
His feet remained planted in the mud like massive iron pillars driven into the bedrock of the earth.
Goliath-9’s internal servos whined in mechanical horror.
[ERROR!
TARGET MASS IS IMMOVABLE!
HYDRAULIC PRESSURE IS OVERLOADING!]
"WHAT...
ARE...
YOU?" the cyborg’s synthetic voice glitched, desperately trying to pull the heavy arm back but it wouldn’t budge.
Silas’s grip held the massive weapon with the unyielding permanence of a mountain.
Silas slowly tilted his head up, looking directly into the glowing red slit of the machine’s optical visor.
CRUNCH!
With a single effortless flex of his fingers, Silas closed his fist.
The heavy titanium-alloy barrels of the rotary cannon crumpled inward like cheap aluminum foil, completely crushing the internal firing pins and shattering the motorized housing.
"You’re very..." Silas replied coldly through his Oni mask.
"Dissapointing."
Silas pulled his right fist back, coiling the muscles in his shoulder like a massive steel spring.

He focused a dense compressed pulse of internal force directly into the heel of his palm and then Silas stepped forward and drove a clean devastating Palm Strike straight into the dead center of Goliath-9’s heavily reinforced titanium chest plating.
KRA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The sound wasn’t a standard metallic thud.
It was a concussive thunderclap that blasted the loose dirt away in a thirty-foot shockwave.
The physical kinetic force didn’t waste its energy denting the heavy outer armor...

Through the terrifying mastery of Silas’s mana, the shockwave bypassed the three-inch-thick steel plating, transmitting the full destructive force straight into the delicate, pressurized life-support chamber suspended deep within the machine’s core.
Inside that steel vault... the small biological human heart that kept the cyborg alive violently, instantly ruptured from the hydrostatic shock.
Splat!
Goliath-9’s entire nine-foot frame instantly went rigid.
The blinding red light in his optical visor flickered erratically for half a second.
Bzzzt... click!
The light died.

The massive multi-ton mechanical titan went completely limp as the pneumatic pressure dropped with a dying hiss, and the monolithic cyborg collapsed backward into the dirt like a falling skyscraper, shaking the entire arena with a massive thud.
Blood-Saint, who had still been clinging to the machine’s ruined spine, was thrown violently through the air by the backblast.
"FUCKKKKK!"
SPLASH!
The priest landed hard in a pool of bloody mud twenty feet away, rolling to his feet with a wet ragged gasp.
Silas didn’t even look at the dead cyborg as he slowly turned his masked head to the side.
At the edge of the cage, Cyber Ghost was desperately trying to drag himself toward the reinforced gate.
He was using his bleeding elbows, his useless, broken legs trailing behind him in the mud.
He looked back over his shoulder with his shattered visor reflecting the terrifying silhouette of the man in the trench coat.
"P-Please..." Cyber Ghost wheezed, blood bubbling past his lips.
"I yield...
I forfeit the match—"𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
Silas walked over to him with calm steps as he didn’t bother offering a cool one-liner.
Silas simply raised his right combat boot and delivered a single heavy kick squarely to the side of the assassin’s temple.
THWACK!
Cyber Ghost’s head whipped violently to the side, his neck snapping with a clean dull pop.
His eyes rolled back into his skull, and the assassin went completely limp, collapsing face-first into the mud.
He wasn’t dead, but his brain had been thoroughly rattled into a deep, concussive coma.
He was officially out of the tournament.
The massive chaotic four-way Royale had just been cleanly reduced to a simple one-on-one which was between Onii-Chan and Blood Saint.
"ONIIIIIIII-CHANNNNNNNNNNNNN!"

chapters.title: Chapter 371: The Final Round [III / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: The stadium fell breathlessly quiet.
Thousands of spectators leaned forward against the cold metal railings, staring down at the blood-soaked pit.
Blood-Saint slowly rose to his feet.
The mud dripped from his ragged priest vestments as he wiped a streak of dark grease and gore from his jaw, spitting a mouthful of coppery phlegm onto the ground.
"Haaaaaa... Haaaaaa...."
And then... something fundamentally changed.
The frantic twitching madness that had consumed the priest since the very first preliminary match completely evaporated from his posture.
His eyes stopped rolling frantically. The manic drooling grin vanished as his face relaxed into a chilling crystalline stillness.
Slide!
Blood-Saint slowly adjusted his bare feet in the mud.
He didn’t take an awkward unstable brawling stance.
He widened his base, dropping his center of gravity flawlessly until his hips were perfectly aligned with his core.
He brought both hands up, tucking his elbows tightly against his floating ribs to completely shield his vital organs.

His weight shifted effortlessly onto the balls of his feet, balanced with the fluid precision of a master Muay Thai fighter, while his hands hovered open in the classic devastating guard of ancient Lethwei bare-knuckle masters.
Silas stopped in his tracks.
Behind the silver fangs of his Oni mask, his Rip-Current Perception scanned the man’s entire structure.
There were no glaring openings, sure a bit of weak points here and there but there was no overextended balance.
Every single tendon, ligament, and muscle fiber across the priest’s scarred body was coiled with deep refined efficiency.

’Oh,’ Silas thought with a genuine spark of surprise flickering in his chest. ’Look at that. He actually knows real, elite martial arts. He isn’t just relying on cheap biological drugs or cybernetic hydraulics like the rest of these underworld bums... He actually trained for this.’
Blood-Saint exhaled a slow frosty breath into the humid air.
WHOOSH!
He moved.
The man didn’t charge like a berserker, he glided across the mud with terrifying frictionless force instead.
He closed the twenty-foot gap in a fraction of a heartbeat, stepping directly into Silas’s inner guard.
He unleashed a master-class combination of powerful strikes.
SNAP!
A lightning-fast lead jab aimed directly at Silas’s throat.
Silas tilted his chin back half an inch, feeling the displaced wind scrape his collar.
CLACK!
Blood-Saint immediately pivoted on his lead foot, rotating his entire torso to bring a vicious downward elbow strike slicing straight toward Silas’s right temple.
Silas brought his left forearm up, intercepting the elbow with a sharp parry.
THUD!
The collision sent a sharp shockwave through Silas’s arm, stinging the nerves.
The priest’s internal mana was fueling his strikes with terrifying power.
’An actual challenge...’
Without breaking momentum, Blood-Saint stepped through the parry, driving a devastating upward spear-knee straight toward Silas’s liver.
BAM!
Silas dropped his right elbow, catching the knee just inches before it could rupture his side.
The two fighters instantly erupted into a breathtaking high-speed hurricane of elite hand-to-hand combat.
SMACK! CLACK! THUD! BANG!
They blurred across the center of the ring, trading blocks, lightning-fast feints, and bone-rattling strikes.
Blood-Saint attacked like a flowing river of knives... spinning back-fists, sweeping low kicks, and devastating close-range headbutts.

Silas was actually forced to actively engage his physical defense, slipping punches by millimeters, deflecting lethal palm strikes with heavy forearm blocks, and returning sharp concussive counters that the priest narrowly parried with master-level footwork.
Sweat, mud, and flecks of blood sprayed into the air with every violent collision.
Up in the stands, the crowd didn’t even cheer.
They were completely spellbound, watching a display of martial perfection rarely seen outside the echelons of the Sovereign Realm.
Silas felt a rare genuine thrill coursing through his veins.
The priest’s technique was undeniably good.
’Well thankfully, I’ve had a lot of practice with the martial arts of this world.’
"You possess divine form!" Blood-Saint hissed between clenched teeth as he parried a heavy hook from Silas and countered with an open-palm strike to Silas’s chest plate.
THUD!
Silas absorbed the heavy blow with his body anchoring his mass without yielding a single inch of ground.
"You’re not bad yourself," Silas admitted bluntly through the mask, stepping forward to press the offensive. "Better than the cyborgs at the very least."
But Silas was not an ordinary martial artist.
He was a Lord.
He possessed a Mythic Gold Core that provided an inexhaustible reservoir of endurance at this level so in a prolonged exchange of pure physical attrition, the laws of biology were on Silas’s side.
Blood-Saint launched a high sweeping roundhouse kick aimed at Silas’s neck.
Silas read the trajectory perfectly. He dipped beneath the sweeping shin, stepping deep into the priest’s exposed center line.
Blood-Saint’s guard was split wide open for a split-second.
Silas seized the opening instantly and he didn’t hold back the output this time.
He rotated his hips, coiling his entire body weight into a massive, full-power devastating straight punch aimed straight at the dead center of Blood-Saint’s solar plexus.
It was a punch designed to shatter the sternum, collapse both lungs, and end the match in a single definitive blow.
SHLUCK!
The sound that echoed across the dirt was not the sharp concussive crack of breaking bone that Silas expected.
It was a wet horrific sound of tearing flesh.
Silas’s eyes widened in genuine shock behind his mask.
The skin, fat, and muscle across Blood-Saint’s stomach were bizarrely soft.
The moment Silas’s knuckles made contact, the flesh didn’t offer an ounce of resistance... it yielded like warm butter instead.
Silas’s entire right hand, wrist, and forearm punched straight through the priest’s abdomen.
His black-gloved fist burst cleanly out through the back of the man’s bloody robes, dripping with dark fluid.
’Fuck...’
He had accidentally impaled him like a pig on a spit.
Silas froze in place, his stomach churning with deep disgust at the wet, boiling heat of the internal organs wrapped tightly around his arm.
’What the hell?!’ Silas thought, horrified. ’I didn’t mean to do that! His body just gave out!’
"Ah..." Blood-Saint let out a soft wet gasp.
A thick stream of dark crimson blood leaked from the corners of his lips yet he didn’t collapse.
He didn’t fall to his knees and he didn’t scream in agony.
It was weird...
Blood-Saint slowly tilted his head down, staring at the massive arm buried straight through his midsection.
Then... he slowly tilted his head back up.
The cold disciplined martial focus in the priest’s eyes instantly shattered as the rabid religious fanaticism returned with ten times its original fury.
"RAHHHHHHHH!"
A wide terrifying smile stretched across Blood-Saint’s face, exposing blood-coated teeth.
"Got you..." Blood-Saint whispered, his voice trembling with ecstasy.
CLENCH!
Instantly, the impossibly soft abdominal muscles and viscera inside the priest’s torso violently, magically contracted.
They constricted around Silas’s forearm with the terrifying bone-crushing pressure of an industrial hydraulic vice.
Silas was completely locked into the man’s body.
Before Silas could forcefully wrench himself free, the massive volume of dark blood pouring from the gaping wound began to unnaturally boil.
HISSSSSSSSSS!
The latent mana trapped within the biological fluid ignited.
Blood Magic.
The dark crimson fluid completely defied gravity.
It surged upward, crawling rapidly up Silas’s trapped arm like a living swarm of crimson leeches.
The magically charged blood generated intense heat, instantly eating through the reinforced fabric of his trench coat and sizzling against his skin.
’Fuck! It just got fixed!’
"You are too dangerous to be allowed to breathe!" Blood-Saint shrieked at the top of his lungs, thick flecks of acidic saliva and blood spraying from his mouth.
His veins pulsed with a blinding toxic violet luminescence.
"MY GOD IS SCREAMING AT ME!" Blood-Saint howled, his voice splitting into multiple demonic frequencies. "HE WANTS YOUR HEAD! HE DEMANDS YOUR SOUL! SACRIFICE! SACRIFICE!"
Silas felt the intense burning heat of the acidic blood attempting to chew through his skin and dissolve his Gold bones.
’Get your disgusting guts off me!’ Silas thought with furious revulsion.
He braced his boots against the mud, lowered his center of gravity, and violently jerked his right arm backward with everything he had.
RRRRRRRRRIP!
With pure brute force, Silas tore his arm completely out of the vice.
The violent extraction ripped a massive dinner-plate-sized chunk of flesh, shredded muscle, and ruptured intestines straight out of the priest’s torso, scattering gore across the dirt.
WHOOSH!
Silas rapidly back-pedaled fifteen feet across the arena, furiously shaking his right arm to fling the sizzling acidic blood off his smoking ruined sleeve.
"Fuck... Fuck... Fuck..."
Blood-Saint didn’t even flinch at the fatal gaping crater in his stomach as he completely lost all remaining vestiges of human sanity.
He went terrifyingly feral.
BUBBLE-HISSSS!
The gallons of boiling blood pouring from his catastrophic torso wound didn’t drop to the earth.
They hung suspended in the air, swirling around him in a dense, crimson vortex before rapidly solidifying into six long razor-sharp tendrils of dense crystallized blood.
They whipped through the air around him like the legs of a monstrous arachnid.
"K-K-K... KILL!" Blood-Saint shrieked, his mind consumed by demonic whispers. "XVESU! THE BLOOD FLOWS! GOR-VASH-TOK! KILL! TEAR THE DEMON! KILL! KILL!"
High above in the rafters, the Syndicate snipers watched the blatant display of external magical manipulation.
"Holy shit! He’s using external magic! He’s bypassing the Null-stone suppression!" the sniper yelled into his comms. "Authorization to eliminate the rogue target!"
"Fire! Fire!" the team lead ordered.
CRACK! CRACK! CRACK!
Three high-velocity armor-piercing kinetic rounds tore down from the ceiling catwalks at three times the speed of sound, aimed straight for Blood-Saint’s temple to enforce the cage’s absolute rules.
Blood-Saint didn’t even look up at the ceiling.
WHIP-CLANG!

Two of the crystallized blood tendrils snapped upward with blinding speed, swatting the supersonic sniper slugs completely out of mid-air like annoying flies, sending loud metallic rings echoing across the dome.
On his hovering platform, the Announcer completely lost his nerve.
He frantically grabbed his encrypted comms unit with both hands, screaming into the channel.

"Boss! Boss, he’s actively bypassing the Null-stone suppression!" the Announcer panicked with his voice cracking. "The cage can’t contain blood magic! Should I drop the emergency blast doors and flood the cage with neurotoxin?!"
CLICK.

"Do not touch that switch," the deep cold voice of the Black-Ash Boss resonated calmly through the earpiece. "Look at the telemetry... The betting pool just hit an all-time record. The audience is captivated so leave the cage open and let them fight to the death."
Down in the mud, Blood-Saint dropped onto all fours with his blood tendrils driving into the earth like spider legs.
"KILL! SACRIFICE THE DEMON! KILL!"
BOOM!
The dirt exploded behind him as Blood-Saint launched himself forward.
The six crystallized blood spears flared with toxic mana, thrusting simultaneously toward Silas’s chest, throat, and eyes with enough force to punch through a battleship hull.
WHOOSH!
Silas stood perfectly still in the center of the ring.
He stared through the narrow slits of his Oni mask at the incoming storm of crimson blades.
’Alright,’ Silas decided. ’I’ve had enough of this circus..’
Silas completely abandoned every single restraint he had placed on his physical output.
FZZZZZZT!
Silas moved so incomprehensibly fast that he simply ceased to occupy the space before the spears could even register his movement.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
THOOM!
The six blood spears pierced empty air, obliterating the dirt where Silas had stood an instant prior.
In the very same second, Silas materialized directly to the left of Blood-Saint’s flank.

Silas drew a massive tidal wave of Mythic Gold Core mana from his core, channeling the concentrated energy straight into the fibers of his right leg as his boot blurred, displacing the atmospheric pressure around his shin into a vacuum.
He stepped through the mud and unleashed a single devastating kick.
KRA-THOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The heavy steel-toed combat boot struck the left side of Blood-Saint’s jaw and the staggering power behind the strike didn’t just break the man’s neck... It didn’t just shatter his skull either.

The shockwave cleanly severed Blood-Saint’s head entirely from his torso, sending the severed skull launching across the arena like a cannonball before it obliterated against the far Null-stone wall in a wet dark red crater.
SPLAT!
For a long agonizing second, the headless mutilated body of the priest remained standing in the center of the dirt.
The six crystallized blood tendrils instantly lost their magical cohesion, collapsing into harmless sizzling puddles of dark fluid in the mud.
THUD!
The headless corpse collapsed heavily onto its chest, going completely still as the entire subterranean colosseum fell silent.
Thousands of people sat frozen in their seats, staring down at the slaughter in the pit. The broken cyborg, the comatose assassin, and the headless priest.
High above, floating on his anti-gravity platform, the Announcer stared down at the carnage with wide trembling eyes.
The microphone shook violently in his sweaty grip.
He swallowed a mouthful of bile, finally finding his voice.
"L-LADIES AND GENTLEMEN..." the Announcer stammered, his voice trembling through the PA system. "THE ROYALE IS OVER! BY CARNAGE... ONII-CHAN IS THE UNDISPUTED CHAMPION OF SHOGITOWN!"

The two fighters instantly erupted into a breathtaking high-speed hurricane of elite hand-to-hand combat.
SMACK!
CLACK!
THUD!
BANG!
They blurred across the center of the ring, trading blocks, lightning-fast feints, and bone-rattling strikes.
Blood-Saint attacked like a flowing river of knives... spinning back-fists, sweeping low kicks, and devastating close-range headbutts.

Silas was actually forced to actively engage his physical defense, slipping punches by millimeters, deflecting lethal palm strikes with heavy forearm blocks, and returning sharp concussive counters that the priest narrowly parried with master-level footwork.
Sweat, mud, and flecks of blood sprayed into the air with every violent collision.
Up in the stands, the crowd didn’t even cheer.
They were completely spellbound, watching a display of martial perfection rarely seen outside the echelons of the Sovereign Realm.
Silas felt a rare genuine thrill coursing through his veins.
The priest’s technique was undeniably good.
’Well thankfully, I’ve had a lot of practice with the martial arts of this world.’
"You possess divine form!" Blood-Saint hissed between clenched teeth as he parried a heavy hook from Silas and countered with an open-palm strike to Silas’s chest plate.
THUD!
Silas absorbed the heavy blow with his body anchoring his mass without yielding a single inch of ground.
"You’re not bad yourself," Silas admitted bluntly through the mask, stepping forward to press the offensive.
"Better than the cyborgs at the very least."
But Silas was not an ordinary martial artist.
He was a Lord.
He possessed a Mythic Gold Core that provided an inexhaustible reservoir of endurance at this level so in a prolonged exchange of pure physical attrition, the laws of biology were on Silas’s side.
Blood-Saint launched a high sweeping roundhouse kick aimed at Silas’s neck.
Silas read the trajectory perfectly.
He dipped beneath the sweeping shin, stepping deep into the priest’s exposed center line.
Blood-Saint’s guard was split wide open for a split-second.
Silas seized the opening instantly and he didn’t hold back the output this time.
He rotated his hips, coiling his entire body weight into a massive, full-power devastating straight punch aimed straight at the dead center of Blood-Saint’s solar plexus.
It was a punch designed to shatter the sternum, collapse both lungs, and end the match in a single definitive blow.
SHLUCK!
The sound that echoed across the dirt was not the sharp concussive crack of breaking bone that Silas expected.
It was a wet horrific sound of tearing flesh.
Silas’s eyes widened in genuine shock behind his mask.
The skin, fat, and muscle across Blood-Saint’s stomach were bizarrely soft.
The moment Silas’s knuckles made contact, the flesh didn’t offer an ounce of resistance... it yielded like warm butter instead.
Silas’s entire right hand, wrist, and forearm punched straight through the priest’s abdomen.
His black-gloved fist burst cleanly out through the back of the man’s bloody robes, dripping with dark fluid.
’Fuck...’
He had accidentally impaled him like a pig on a spit.
Silas froze in place, his stomach churning with deep disgust at the wet, boiling heat of the internal organs wrapped tightly around his arm.
’What the hell?!’ Silas thought, horrified. ’I didn’t mean to do that!
His body just gave out!’
"Ah..." Blood-Saint let out a soft wet gasp.
A thick stream of dark crimson blood leaked from the corners of his lips yet he didn’t collapse.
He didn’t fall to his knees and he didn’t scream in agony.
It was weird...
Blood-Saint slowly tilted his head down, staring at the massive arm buried straight through his midsection.
Then... he slowly tilted his head back up.
The cold disciplined martial focus in the priest’s eyes instantly shattered as the rabid religious fanaticism returned with ten times its original fury.
"RAHHHHHHHH!"
A wide terrifying smile stretched across Blood-Saint’s face, exposing blood-coated teeth.
"Got you..." Blood-Saint whispered, his voice trembling with ecstasy.
CLENCH!
Instantly, the impossibly soft abdominal muscles and viscera inside the priest’s torso violently, magically contracted.
They constricted around Silas’s forearm with the terrifying bone-crushing pressure of an industrial hydraulic vice.
Silas was completely locked into the man’s body.
Before Silas could forcefully wrench himself free, the massive volume of dark blood pouring from the gaping wound began to unnaturally boil.
HISSSSSSSSSS!
The latent mana trapped within the biological fluid ignited.
Blood Magic.
The dark crimson fluid completely defied gravity.
It surged upward, crawling rapidly up Silas’s trapped arm like a living swarm of crimson leeches.
The magically charged blood generated intense heat, instantly eating through the reinforced fabric of his trench coat and sizzling against his skin.
’Fuck!
It just got fixed!’
"You are too dangerous to be allowed to breathe!" Blood-Saint shrieked at the top of his lungs, thick flecks of acidic saliva and blood spraying from his mouth.
His veins pulsed with a blinding toxic violet luminescence.
"MY GOD IS SCREAMING AT ME!" Blood-Saint howled, his voice splitting into multiple demonic frequencies.
"HE WANTS YOUR HEAD!
HE DEMANDS YOUR SOUL!
SACRIFICE!
SACRIFICE!"
Silas felt the intense burning heat of the acidic blood attempting to chew through his skin and dissolve his Gold bones.
’Get your disgusting guts off me!’ Silas thought with furious revulsion.
He braced his boots against the mud, lowered his center of gravity, and violently jerked his right arm backward with everything he had.
RRRRRRRRRIP!
With pure brute force, Silas tore his arm completely out of the vice.
The violent extraction ripped a massive dinner-plate-sized chunk of flesh, shredded muscle, and ruptured intestines straight out of the priest’s torso, scattering gore across the dirt.
WHOOSH!
Silas rapidly back-pedaled fifteen feet across the arena, furiously shaking his right arm to fling the sizzling acidic blood off his smoking ruined sleeve.
"Fuck...
Fuck...
Fuck..."
Blood-Saint didn’t even flinch at the fatal gaping crater in his stomach as he completely lost all remaining vestiges of human sanity.
He went terrifyingly feral.
BUBBLE-HISSSS!
The gallons of boiling blood pouring from his catastrophic torso wound didn’t drop to the earth.
They hung suspended in the air, swirling around him in a dense, crimson vortex before rapidly solidifying into six long razor-sharp tendrils of dense crystallized blood.
They whipped through the air around him like the legs of a monstrous arachnid.
KILL!" Blood-Saint shrieked, his mind consumed by demonic whispers.
"XVESU!
THE BLOOD FLOWS!
GOR-VASH-TOK!
KILL!
TEAR THE DEMON!
KILL!
KILL!"
High above in the rafters, the Syndicate snipers watched the blatant display of external magical manipulation.
"Holy shit!
He’s using external magic!
He’s bypassing the Null-stone suppression!" the sniper yelled into his comms.
"Authorization to eliminate the rogue target!"
"Fire!
Fire!" the team lead ordered.
CRACK!
CRACK!
CRACK!
Three high-velocity armor-piercing kinetic rounds tore down from the ceiling catwalks at three times the speed of sound, aimed straight for Blood-Saint’s temple to enforce the cage’s absolute rules.
Blood-Saint didn’t even look up at the ceiling.
WHIP-CLANG!

Two of the crystallized blood tendrils snapped upward with blinding speed, swatting the supersonic sniper slugs completely out of mid-air like annoying flies, sending loud metallic rings echoing across the dome.
On his hovering platform, the Announcer completely lost his nerve.
He frantically grabbed his encrypted comms unit with both hands, screaming into the channel.
"Boss!
Boss, he’s actively bypassing the Null-stone suppression!" the Announcer panicked with his voice cracking.
"The cage can’t contain blood magic!
Should I drop the emergency blast doors and flood the cage with neurotoxin?!"
CLICK.
"Do not touch that switch," the deep cold voice of the Black-Ash Boss resonated calmly through the earpiece.
"Look at the telemetry...
The betting pool just hit an all-time record.
The audience is captivated so leave the cage open and let them fight to the death."
Down in the mud, Blood-Saint dropped onto all fours with his blood tendrils driving into the earth like spider legs.
"KILL!
SACRIFICE THE DEMON!
KILL!"
BOOM!
The dirt exploded behind him as Blood-Saint launched himself forward.
The six crystallized blood spears flared with toxic mana, thrusting simultaneously toward Silas’s chest, throat, and eyes with enough force to punch through a battleship hull.
WHOOSH!
Silas stood perfectly still in the center of the ring.
He stared through the narrow slits of his Oni mask at the incoming storm of crimson blades.
’Alright,’ Silas decided. ’I’ve had enough of this circus..’
Silas completely abandoned every single restraint he had placed on his physical output.
FZZZZZZT!
Silas moved so incomprehensibly fast that he simply ceased to occupy the space before the spears could even register his movement.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
THOOM!
The six blood spears pierced empty air, obliterating the dirt where Silas had stood an instant prior.
In the very same second, Silas materialized directly to the left of Blood-Saint’s flank.

Silas drew a massive tidal wave of Mythic Gold Core mana from his core, channeling the concentrated energy straight into the fibers of his right leg as his boot blurred, displacing the atmospheric pressure around his shin into a vacuum.
He stepped through the mud and unleashed a single devastating kick.
KRA-THOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The heavy steel-toed combat boot struck the left side of Blood-Saint’s jaw and the staggering power behind the strike didn’t just break the man’s neck...
It didn’t just shatter his skull either.

The shockwave cleanly severed Blood-Saint’s head entirely from his torso, sending the severed skull launching across the arena like a cannonball before it obliterated against the far Null-stone wall in a wet dark red crater.
SPLAT!
For a long agonizing second, the headless mutilated body of the priest remained standing in the center of the dirt.
The six crystallized blood tendrils instantly lost their magical cohesion, collapsing into harmless sizzling puddles of dark fluid in the mud.
THUD!
The headless corpse collapsed heavily onto its chest, going completely still as the entire subterranean colosseum fell silent.
Thousands of people sat frozen in their seats, staring down at the slaughter in the pit.
The broken cyborg, the comatose assassin, and the headless priest.
High above, floating on his anti-gravity platform, the Announcer stared down at the carnage with wide trembling eyes.
The microphone shook violently in his sweaty grip.
He swallowed a mouthful of bile, finally finding his voice.
"L-LADIES AND GENTLEMEN..." the Announcer stammered, his voice trembling through the PA system.
"THE ROYALE IS OVER!
BY CARNAGE...
ONII-CHAN IS THE UNDISPUTED CHAMPION OF SHOGITOWN!"

chapters.title: Chapter 372: Meeting With The Boss Of The Black-Ash Syndicate
paragraphs: "RAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!"
The silence shattered as the entire stadium erupted into a feral deafening roar of pandemonium.
They cheered, they screamed, they cursed, throwing their arms in the air at the most violent spectacle the Underworld had seen in a decade.
Down in the blood-soaked dirt, Silas slowly lowered his right leg.
He casually brushed a speck of dirt off the sleeve of his dark trench coat, ignoring the screaming crowd above.

’His god explicitly ordered him to kill me?’ Silas thought, replaying the crazed priest’s final words in his mind. ’Did I somehow piss off an ancient blood deity just by crossing over into this world?’
The only one he knew he pissed off was Ititius and the guy was dead.
’I don’t want to think about it...’
Silas let out a tired sigh, stretching his broad shoulders.
Click! Clack! Click! Clack!
The distinct sound of high heels stepping through the wet mud approached from directly behind him.
Silas turned his silver Oni mask around.
Walking casually into the blood-soaked gore-drenched arena, entirely unfazed by the shattered cyborg chassis and the headless corpse, was the wicked black-haired receptionist.
Her tailored black corporate suit was pristine as she stopped just five feet away from him, crossing her arms beneath her chest as an amused predatory smile curled across her dark lips.
"Congratulations on surviving the meat grinder, Onii-chan," she purred smoothly, her dark eyes running slowly down his broad frame.
She turned on her heel, gesturing toward the open executive access hatch behind her.
"Follow me," the receptionist commanded. "My father is waiting in the penthouse suite to discuss your reward and your lovely Manager is already up there waiting for you."
Silas didn’t reply.
He stuffed his hands deep into his coat pockets and followed behind her, leaving the roaring colosseum and the reek of boiling blood behind.
The heavy steel hatch slammed shut behind them with a definitive, pressurized thud, instantly cutting off eighty percent of the crowd’s noise.
’Good riddance... having people cheer for me when they aren’t my girls is weird.’
Not to mention that most of them were cursing him for losing their bets, why did they even bet on the others when it was obvious Silas was going to win from the very beginning?
The corridor beyond was immaculate... lined with sound-dampening acoustic velvet panels, illuminated by soft golden strip lighting recessed into the polished marble floor.
At the end of the private corridor stood an ornate gilded elevator door.
DING!
The hydraulic doors hissed open, revealing a mirrored interior lit with warm amber luminescence.
The receptionist stepped inside with fluid grace, and Silas followed with his boots leaving small streaks of dried arena mud on the polished floor.
She tapped the top button on the executive console... a solid platinum dial marked with the emblem of the Black-Ash Syndicate which was a skull wreathed in smoldering embers.
HUMMMMMM.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
The elevator engaged its magnetic dampeners and began ascending rapidly through the bedrock, climbing hundreds of feet up into the upper executive spires carved into the roof of the cavern.
For a long moment, the only sound was the steady hum of the elevator’s anti-gravity cables.
The receptionist leaned her shoulder against the mirrored wall, crossing her arms beneath her chest.
Her dark kohl-lined eyes lazily traced Silas’s broad frame from head to toe, lingering unapologetically on his lower back and hips.
"So," she began smoothly, tilting her head with an amused smile. "Since we’re going to be doing serious business together in about two minutes... my name is Talia. Just Talia."
Silas kept his eyes fixed forward on the digital floor counter ticking upward.
"Congratulations."
Talia’s eyebrow twitched slightly.
She scoffed, blowing a stray strand of jet-black hair from her face.

"I gave you my name, you muscle-bound freak. The polite thing to do is return the favor and don’t give me that ridiculous, juvenile ’Onii-chan’ crap. I want the actual name on your identification card."
Silas didn’t even turn his head. His voice rumbled through the Oni mask, lacking any sort of interest.
"Talia," Silas commented dryly, testing the syllables. "Sounds like an expensive brand of laundry detergent."
"Tch." Talia clicked her tongue, her jaw tightening in genuine irritation.

She pushed off the mirrored wall and stepped a fraction of an inch closer to him, her perfume... a sharp intoxicating blend of night-blooming jasmine and expensive synth-tobacco filling the enclosed space.

"You know," Talia muttered, narrowing her eyes as she looked up into the dark slits of his silver demon mask, "most men who step into this district would sell their left lung just to have me look at them for five consecutive seconds... You’re walking into a private meeting with the most dangerous mafia lord in the Underworld, yet you’re acting like you’re waiting in line at a grocery store."
"I want to focus on the meeting," Silas stated bluntly, keeping his hands buried in his pockets. "I’m here to collect a bounty, get paid, and leave this cesspool. Small talk burns daylight."
Talia stared at his stoic unmoving profile in utter disbelief before turning her back on him with an annoyed huff.

’Why the hell does this guy have such an absurdly nice ass when his personality is as dry as compressed cardboard?’ Talia complained bitterly in her thoughts, crossing her arms tightly. ’He could split a cyborg in half with his bare hands, but he can’t manage basic human conversation? What a complete waste of prime genetic material.’
DING!
The elevator slowed to a smooth frictionless halt on the absolute top floor.
The gilded doors slid open, revealing an enormous executive landing guarded by four massive augmented syndicate enforcers.
Each guard was clad in matte-black composite ballistic armor, holding heavy assault rifles strapped across their chests.
The targeting lasers built into their temples flashed across Silas’s mask for half a second before deactivating upon recognizing Talia.
"Mistress Talia," the lead guard acknowledged with a stiff formal bow.
"Move," Talia ordered coldly, stepping past them without breaking stride.

The guards formed a tight escort formation around Silas, escorting him down a wide vaulted hallway lined with high-end glass display cases containing antique bladed weapons, preserved demonic monster cores, and rare Sovereign Realm artifacts.
At the end of the grand hallway stood a set of towering double doors made from solid petrified ironwood, reinforced with dark steel filigree.
PSSH-T!
The heavy doors hissed open automatically, parting to reveal the expansive panoramic executive office of the Syndicate Boss.
The room was immense.
The entire far wall was made of reinforced, floor-to-ceiling polarized glass overlooking the glowing, neon-drenched expanse of Shogitown below.
A sprawling desk carved from a single slab of black obsidian dominated the center of the room, flanked by plush leather lounge chairs and crystal decanters of amber liquor.
Sitting behind the obsidian desk was the Boss of the Black-Ash Syndicate.
Silas’s eyes sharpened behind his mask, taking in the man’s physical features.
The Boss possessed striking shoulder-length silver-and-white hair, combed neatly back from a noble face lined with subtle trace-lines.
His eyes were a piercing cold slate gray, carrying the distinct sharpness of a seasoned predator.
His physical resemblance to Talia was unmistakable... the same sharp jawline and the same dangerous posture.

’So this is Jax’s father,’ Silas noted internally, analyzing the man’s facial structure. ’Which means that shut-in hacker is probably going to have the exact same silver hair and sharp face once we scrape the basement dirt off him.’
The moment Silas stepped fully across the threshold, the air in the room suddenly grew heavy.
HUMMM!
A subtle invisible pressure rippled through the space.

Silas felt a sharp, intrusive mental tendril... an ethereal probe attempting to bore directly through his skull to pry into his thoughts, read his surface intentions, and measure the depth of his internal energy.
’Prying into a Lord’s mind?’ Silas scoffed internally. ’Amateur.’
Silas didn’t even need to use an active counter-spell. He simply flexed the power of his Core.
SNAP!
A pulse of pure internal mana flared through his neural pathways as the invisible mental probe was shattered like a thin pane of glass struck by a warhammer.
Across the desk, the Boss’s slate-gray eyes widened by a fraction of a millimeter.
A sharp intake of breath hissed past his teeth as the feedback of the broken mental probe snapped back into his own mind.
He masked his shock instantly, smoothing his expression back into an immaculate professional smile.
"Welcome, Champion," the Boss spoke. "And welcome back, Talia."
PSSH-CHUNK!
The heavy ironwood doors slammed shut behind Silas, locking with a series of heavy deadbolts.
The four guards remained outside in the hallway, leaving only Silas, Talia, the Boss, and a single figure seated on the leather lounge chair to the side.
Silas glanced over.
Evelyn was sitting on the left side of the obsidian desk.
She was still wearing her hoodie and her painted porcelain Kitsune mask but something was visibly wrong.
Her exposed skin was deathly pale.
Her small, leather-gloved hands were clenched tightly into fists on her knees, and Silas could clearly see her slender frame trembling with subtle tremors.

’What happened to her?’ Silas thought, frowning behind his Oni mask. ’She was screaming about winning sixty million credits not too long ago. Why is she shivering like she just got pulled out of a frozen lake?’
The Boss leaned back in his high-backed leather chair, steepling his fingers over the black obsidian surface.

"First and foremost, allow me to extend my personal gratitude, Contestant," the Boss said smoothly, his eyes tracking Silas as the young man walked toward the seating area. "It was entirely because of your... aggressive efficiency in the cage that my syndicate managed to eliminate several problematic elements from our books."
Silas didn’t say a word as he just listened.

"Zarch was an unstable chemically-altered maniac skimming from our distribution channels," the Boss continued casually, as if discussing the weather. "The Blood-Saint was an uncontrollable religious lunatic who was beginning to attract unwanted heat from the higher sects and Goliath-9 was a corporate spy operating on behalf of the Iron-Core Cartel... You saved my enforcers weeks of messy cleanup work."
From that brief cold explanation, Silas could immediately deduce what this entire underground tournament had actually been designed for.

’The whole bloodbath was just a glorified corporate restructuring,’ Silas thought. ’The guy used a tournament bracket to lure all his internal rivals and problematic assets into a suppressed cage so they could kill each other off under the guise of public entertainment... I’m impressed.’
Though, Silas really didn’t see how any of those fighters could have ever posed a legitimate existential threat to an organized syndicate.
To Silas, they had all been laughably weak.
’Or maybe...’ Silas paused, correcting himself with a mild shrug. ’Maybe my Gold Core just makes everyone else look like tissue paper.’
Well that was the truth.
"Please, take a seat," the Boss offered, gesturing toward the empty leather chair directly beside Evelyn.
Silas walked over and dropped into the chair. His boots thumped against the floor, leaving a small cloud of arena dust in the pristine executive air.
Talia walked around the desk, taking her place standing directly beside her father’s right shoulder, crossing her arms and maintaining a sharp watchful gaze on the two masked Lords.
The Boss cleared his throat, leaning his forearms against the obsidian desk.

"You two are here to collect your official tournament reward, correct?" the Boss asked, his slate-gray eyes shifting between Silas and the trembling Evelyn. "Given how exceptionally stiff both of you appear, I am going to assume you expect me to renege on our agreement and make this process exceptionally difficult for you."
Silas tilted his masked head upward, watching the man’s micro-expressions.
"I am well aware," the Boss continued in a calm tone, "that you almost decapitated my eldest son during the preliminary qualifiers."
Silas didn’t flinch.

"However," the Boss smiled with a thin sharp grin that lacked any paternal warmth, "the Black-Ash Syndicate did not rise to rule Shogitown by breaking our contractual word... We pride ourselves on being honorable businessmen. The asset you requested... my disgraced runaway son will be formally handed over to your custody. His tracking chips have been surgically extracted, and the administrative master control of his Slave Rune will be transferred to you directly... After that, whatever you choose to do with him outside of Shogitown is entirely your concern."
Silas let out a quiet internal sigh of relief behind his metal mask.
’Good,’ Silas thought. ’But I’m still surprised...’
He didn’t have a good feeling about this, his life was full of drama... Did the Boss seriously not want to do anything?

"However," the Boss cleared his throat, tapping a holographic interface embedded directly into the obsidian desk, "before we discuss the transfer of assets, we must settle the financial matter of your betting earnings."
Silas glanced sideways at Evelyn.
She hadn’t moved an inch.
Her breathing was shallow, and her fingers were digging so violently into the leather of her gloves that her knuckles were popping.
’Seriously, what is her problem?’ Silas wondered. ’Evelyn is a Classic Lord so why is she completely frozen in front of an Underworld boss?’
